AI.title_translation: 利用LLM引导插桩的JavaScript引擎状态感知模糊测试
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种利用大语言模型引导插桩的JS引擎状态感知模糊测试框架StateLens，突破了传统覆盖率瓶颈并发现了68个新漏洞。
AI.motivation: 现代JS引擎的模糊测试面临“覆盖率停滞”瓶颈，传统的边缘覆盖率无法区分共享相同边缘但内部状态不同的复杂引擎行为（如JIT优化层级和隐藏类转换），导致深层错误难以触发。
AI.method: 提出StateLens框架，包含一个基于智能体（agent）的推理流水线，利用LLM迭代分析代码与开发者注释，智能选择高价值的内部状态插桩目标，并采用双重反馈机制引导模糊测试器。
AI.result: 评估表明，StateLens显著优于现有的先进模糊测试工具，成功发现了68个新漏洞。
AI.conclusion: StateLens框架成功解决了JS引擎模糊测试中的覆盖率停滞问题，通过LLM引导的智能插桩与双重反馈机制，能够有效探索深层内部状态并发现大量新漏洞。
AI.translation: 现代网络的安全性依赖于JavaScript（JS）引擎的正确性，然而这些复杂的系统仍然容易受到高影响力漏洞的攻击。最先进的模糊测试工具的一个关键局限性是覆盖率停滞：一旦模糊测试器饱和了控制流图，边缘覆盖率就失去了引导发现的能力。由于复杂的引擎行为（如JIT优化层级和隐藏 class 转换）通常共享相同的边缘覆盖率，标准覆盖率指标无法识别触发深层错误所需的独特内部状态。为了弥补这一差距，我们提出了StateLens，一个利用大语言模型（LLM）自动化发现深层内部状态的框架。由于庞大的状态空间和高的运行时开销，盲目地在所有状态放置插桩探针是不可行的。StateLens引入了一种新颖的基于智能体的推理流水线，模仿了安全研究人员的直觉。通过迭代遍历代码和开发人员的注释，我们的智能体智能地选择高价值的插桩目标，有效地将驱动逻辑的状态变量与不相关的数据区分开来。这产生了可合成的高信号反馈探针，映射出引擎的隐藏配置。这种插桩馈送双重反馈机制，有效地引导模糊测试器朝向未探索的引擎语义。我们的评估证实，StateLens显著优于最先进的模糊测试工具，并发现了68个新漏洞。
AI.summary: 本文提出了StateLens，一个利用大语言模型自动发现JavaScript引擎深层内部状态的模糊测试框架。该框架通过智能体推理选择高价值的插桩目标，生成高信号的反馈探针，并结合双重反馈机制指导模糊测试，最终在JS引擎测试中展现出卓越性能并发现了68个新漏洞。
AI.keywords: JavaScript引擎, 模糊测试, 大语言模型, 状态感知, 代码插桩
AI.comments: 该论文创新性地将大语言模型（LLM）与传统模糊测试相结合，通过智能选择高价值的内部状态插桩点，突破了现有JS引擎模糊测试中边缘覆盖率陷入停滞的瓶颈。这为处理复杂软件系统中的深层状态探索提供了一个极具前景的新范式。

title: Smoothness as a Constraint for Stable Humanoid Locomotion
summary: Embodied AI systems, particularly humanoid robots deployed in real world scenarios require whole-body control policies that are both task-responsive and physically smooth. However, smoothness is not uniform across the body: lower body must remain sufficiently reactive, while the upper body must be tightly regulated to preserve stability. Existing reinforcement learning approaches typically impose smoothness through auxiliary terms in the reward function, which compete with task objectives, treating the body as uniform and provide no direct control over the physical quantities responsible for smooth behavior. We introduce DeCap (Decoupled Constraint-aware policy), a constrained reinforcement learning algorithm that decouples whole-body smoothness into separate upper- and lower-body constraint groups, each formulates smoothness as explicit constraints on physical motion limits. To improve constraint satisfaction near feasibility boundaries, DeCap incorporates a bounded barrier penalty that activates proactively as limits are approached and remains bounded at the constraint limit. On real-world humanoid whole-body control task, DeCap reduces upper-body action rate by 2.50x and acceleration by 2.18x relative to reward-based smoothness policies, while also improving lower-body smoothness and reducing transient motion. We demonstrate that a fixed set of smoothness constraints transfers across diverse terrains, alleviating the need of extensive reward tuning.

AI.title_translation: 平滑度作为稳定人形机器人 locomotion 的约束条件
AI.tldr: 提出了一种名为DeCap的强化学习算法，通过对人形机器人上下半身施加解耦的显式平滑度约束，显著提升了机器人在现实世界中的运动稳定性和跨地形泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 现有的强化学习方法通常通过奖励函数中的辅助项来强加平滑度，这与任务目标相互冲突，将身体视为均质的，并且无法直接控制导致平滑行为的物理量。为了满足具身AI系统（尤其是人形机器人）对上半身严格调节稳定性和下半身保持反应性的双重需求。
AI.method: 提出了一种名为DeCap（解耦约束感知策略）的受约束强化学习算法，将全身平滑度解耦为独立的上下半身约束组，将平滑度表述为对物理运动限制的显式约束，并引入了在接近可行性边界时主动激活的有界障碍惩罚（bounded barrier penalty）。
AI.result: 在真实世界的人形机器人全身控制任务中，相比于基于奖励的平滑策略，DeCap将上半身动作速率降低了2.50倍，加速度降低了2.18倍，同时改善了下半身平滑度并减少了瞬态运动，且固定的平滑度约束可跨越不同地形进行迁移。
AI.conclusion: DeCap算法通过解耦上下半身的显式平滑度约束与有界障碍惩罚，有效解决了人形机器人全身控制中的平滑性与反应性矛盾，实现了无需繁琐奖励调节的高效现实世界策略迁移。
AI.translation: 具身AI系统，特别是部署在现实场景中的人形机器人，需要既具备任务响应能力又在物理上保持平滑的全身控制策略。然而，平滑度在身体各部位并非均一：下半身必须保持足够的反应能力，而上半身必须受到严格调节以维持稳定性。现有的强化学习方法通常通过奖励函数中的辅助项来强加平滑度，这些辅助项与任务目标相竞争，将身体视为均质的，且无法直接控制负责平滑行为的物理量。我们引入了DeCap（解耦约束感知策略），这是一种受约束的强化学习算法，它将全身平滑度解耦为独立的上、下半身约束组，每组将平滑度表述为对物理运动限制的显式约束。为了改善可行性边界附近的约束满足度，DeCap结合了一个有界障碍惩罚，当接近限制时该惩罚主动激活，并在约束限制处保持有界。在真实世界的人形机器人全身控制任务中，DeCap相对于基于奖励的平滑策略，将上半身动作速率降低了2.50倍，加速度降低了2.18倍，同时也改善了下半身平滑度并减少了瞬态运动。我们证明了一组固定的平滑度约束可以跨越不同的地形进行迁移，从而减轻了进行大量奖励调节的需求。
AI.summary: 该论文提出了DeCap算法，这是一种针对人形机器人的受约束强化学习方法，通过将平滑度转化为上下半身分离的物理运动显式约束，并结合有界障碍惩罚机制，实现了高稳定性和任务响应性的全身控制，且无需复杂的奖励调整即可泛化至多种地形。
AI.keywords: 人形机器人, 全身控制, 强化学习, 运动平滑度, 约束优化
AI.comments: 该论文创新性地将平滑度从奖励函数的软约束转化为物理运动限制的显式约束，并通过解耦上下半身策略以及引入有界障碍惩罚函数，显著提升了人形机器人在现实世界中的运动稳定性和策略迁移能力。

title: Toward a Unified Mathematics of Concepts
summary: Concepts are commonly defined as abstract, compact representations of knowledge and treated as basic units of intelligent behavior. Yet, cognition, psychology, and AI lack a shared mathematical language for them. Modern systems represent concepts as vectors, distributions, symbols, graphs, and other structures, but these formalisms are typically treated as competing rather than as solutions to a common problem. We propose an operation-based view that evaluates mathematical frameworks by the conceptual operations they support, identifying thirteen operations (including similarity, composition, generalization, and grounding) that recur across cognition, psychology, and AI. We show that ten frameworks embody distinct commitments to concepts as self-contained content, relational structure, or evolving process, and that these commitments determine which operations each supports naturally. For example, vector-based models facilitate graded similarity and generalization but struggle with explicit composition, whereas symbolic models support composition but offer but generalize poorly. No single framework we examined naturally supports all operations without extension. We test this account empirically using categorization as a case study, operationalizing nine theories on the same items against human judgments. Despite addressing the same conceptual question, the theories produce different procedures and results, demonstrating that mathematical commitment shapes what a theory can explain. We call for hybrid formalisms that treat content, relation, and process as jointly primary.

title: The Endless Exam: Mathematical Constructions from Today's Models toward Superintelligence
summary: We introduce the Endless Exam, a benchmark for measuring mathematical progress from today's models toward artificial superintelligence through fourteen parameterised construction families. Each submitted object is checked automatically for validity and assigned a relative quality score against a published frontier or construction baseline, without capping improvements at $1$. The families draw on open mathematical problems for long-term targets and generate new instances at larger parameters, where compact certificates keep large constructions verifiable. Across eight models evaluated on 69 distinct instances, continuous quality scores distinguish performance even though no evaluated system surpasses a published frontier. Size-quality curves show how construction quality changes as problem size increases. We release the generators, verifiers, references, model responses and analysis to support continued measurement before and beyond human frontiers.

AI.title_translation: 无尽的考试：从当今模型到超级智能的数学构造
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种名为“无尽考试”的新基准，通过参数化数学构造族的无上限相对质量评分，来评估当前AI模型向超智能迈进的数学能力。
AI.motivation: 当前评估模型能力的基准在面对向人工智能超智能（ASI）迈进的进展时存在局限性，缺乏能够衡量长远数学目标、突破现有上限并不断生成新实例的测试手段。
AI.method: 引入包含十四个参数化构造族的Endless Exam基准，自动检查提交对象的有效性，并根据已发布的前沿或构造基准分配无上限的相对质量分数，利用紧凑证书保持大型构造的可验证性。
AI.result: 在69个不同实例上对8个模型进行的评估表明，连续质量分数能够有效区分模型性能，尽管目前没有一个被评估的系统超越已发布的数学前沿。
AI.conclusion: 无上限的连续质量评分和紧凑证书验证机制，为评估当前及未来人工智能向超智能迈进的数学能力提供了一个可行且可扩展的测试平台。
AI.translation: 我们引入了“无尽考试”（Endless Exam），这是一个通过十四个参数化构造族来衡量从当今模型到人工智能超智能的数学进展的基准。每个提交的对象都会自动检查其有效性，并根据已发布的前沿或构造基准分配相对质量分数，且对改进没有设置1的上限。这些构造族借鉴了开放性数学问题作为长期目标，并在更大的参数下生成新的实例，其中紧凑的证书使大型构造保持可验证性。在对69个不同实例进行评估的八个模型中，连续质量分数区分了性能，尽管没有一个被评估的系统超过已发布的前沿。大小-质量曲线显示了构造质量如何随着问题规模的增加而变化。我们发布了生成器、验证器、参考资料、模型响应和分析，以支持在人类前沿之前和之后的持续测量。
AI.summary: 本文介绍了“无尽考试”（Endless Exam）这一新型基准测试，旨在通过14个参数化数学构造族来衡量当前AI向超级智能发展的数学进展。该基准利用自动验证、无上限的相对质量评分以及紧凑证书，能够随问题规模扩大持续生成和验证新实例，并在8个模型的测试中成功区分了其性能表现。
AI.keywords: 数学构造, 人工智能超智能, 基准测试, 开放数学问题, 形式验证
AI.comments: 该论文提出了一种独特的数学构造基准，通过无上限的相对质量评分和紧凑证明机制，能够有效评估当前AI模型向超智能迈进过程中的数学能力进展，填补了超越人类前沿评估的空白。

title: $t_0$: A Time-Series Foundation Model for Forecasting with Context
summary: We present $t_0$, a family of open-weights foundation models for forecasting with multivariate context. We release its first two members: $\texttt{t0-alpha}$ and $\texttt{t0-beta}$, respectively 102M and 256M parameters. Both condition their forecasts on target history, past covariates, and known-future covariates, without task-specific retraining. Their transformer layers alternate attention along time and across variates. They produce probabilistic forecasts through quantile predictions. Pretraining combines curated public data with synthetic generator families constructed to contain covariate-to-target dependencies. On GIFT-Eval, $\texttt{t0-alpha}$ reaches an aggregate CRPS of 0.4941, and $\texttt{t0-beta}$ a CRPS of 0.4738 and a MASE of 0.6865, third on both and within 4.0% of the best zero-shot TSFM. On fev-bench they score 42.2 and 46.7 in skill, the latter third again and 2.0 points behind the leader. We analyze $\texttt{t0-alpha}$ in depth. Known-future covariates raise its skill by 6.3 percentage points across 30 tasks. The report also examines its calibration, its rollout strategy on long horizons, and its robustness to missing data. On the Victoria electricity-demand benchmark, $\texttt{t0-beta}$ is among the most accurate models with a context of nearly a year. In an independent Macrocosm evaluation of hourly ERCOT prices over 29 months, both cut the MAE of the lagged-price baseline by 38%.

AI.title_translation: $t_0$：一个用于结合上下文进行预测的时间序列基础模型
AI.tldr: 本文提出了t0系列开源时间序列基础模型，能够在无需任务特定微调的情况下，利用多变量上下文进行高效的零样本预测。
AI.motivation: 开发能够在多变量上下文下进行预测且无需任务特定 retraining 的开源时间序列基础模型。
AI.method: 采用了交替时间和变量注意力的Transformer架构，通过分位数预测产生概率预测，并在包含公开数据与合成生成器的混合数据上进行预训练。
AI.result: 在GIFT-Eval和fev-bench等基准测试中表现优异（如t0-beta的CRPS达0.4738，MASE为0.6865），在Victoria电力需求和ERCOT价格预测中也展现了极高的准确性与鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: t0模型作为开源的时间序列基础模型，在无需任务特定微调的情况下，在多个公开基准测试中展现了极具竞争力的零样本预测性能。
AI.translation: 我们提出了 $t_0$，这是一系列用于结合多变量上下文进行预测的开源权重基础模型。我们发布了它的前两个成员：$\texttt{t0-alpha}$ 和 $\texttt{t0-beta}$，参数量分别为 102M 和 256M。两者都在没有任务特定重新训练的情况下，将目标历史、过去协变量和已知未来协变量作为预测条件。它们的 Transformer 层交替进行时间和跨变量的注意力计算。它们通过分位数预测产生概率预测。预训练结合了精选的公共数据和包含协变量到目标依赖关系的合成生成器家族。在 GIFT-Eval 上，$\texttt{t0-alpha}$ 的聚合 CRPS 达到 0.4941，$\texttt{t0-beta}$ 的 CRPS 达到 0.4738，MASE 为 0.6865，两者在这两项指标上均排名第三，且在最佳零样本 TSFM 的 4.0% 范围内。在 fev-bench 上，它们的技能得分分别为 42.2 和 46.7，后者再次排名第三，落后领先者 2.0 分。我们对 $\texttt{t0-alpha}$ 进行了深入分析。已知未来协变量将其在 30 个任务中的技能提高了 6.3 个百分点。报告还检查了其校准性、长视界滚动策略以及对缺失数据的鲁棒性。在维多利亚电力需求基准测试中，$\texttt{t0-beta}$ 在拥有近一年上下文的情况下是最准确的模型之一。在对 29 个月内每小时 ERCOT 价格的独立 Macrocosm 评估中，两者的 MAE 比滞后价格基线减少了 38%。
AI.summary: 本文介绍了t0（包含t0-alpha和t0-beta两个开源权重版本），这是一个用于多变量上下文预测的时间序列基础模型。它通过特殊的注意力机制和预训练策略，在无需微调的情况下实现了强大的零样本概率预测。
AI.keywords: 时间序列基础模型, 预测, 多变量上下文, 零样本学习, 变压器架构
AI.comments: 该论文提出了t0系列时间序列基础模型，通过交替注意力和结合真实与合成数据的预训练策略，在多变量上下文预测任务中展现了优异的零样本泛化能力和鲁棒性。

title: Evaluating Transformation Models for pCLE Mosaic Registration
summary: Confocal Laser Endomicroscopy (CLE) provides real-time, cellular-resolution optical biopsy but has a narrow field of view, which image mosaicing can extend to provide anatomical context. Because of line-by-line acquisition, probe motion, and probe-tissue interaction, frame alignment generally requires a non-linear transformation whose accuracy is difficult to quantify: flexible transformation models can fit intensity features and noise, so appearance-based metrics such as Normalized Cross-Correlation (NCC) can improve without a genuine gain in geometric accuracy. We therefore establish a dataset of 132 frame pairs across fourteen pCLE sequences from 4 patients with manually annotated landmark correspondences, so that Target Registration Error (TRE) can serve as a geometrically grounded complement to NCC. We assess the effect of progressively increasing the transformation model's degrees of freedom, from translation to Thin Plate Spline (TPS), and of six feature-matching backends spanning classical (Shi-Tomasi, Lucas-Kanade) and learned (SuperPoint, SuperGlue, LightGlue, LoFTR, RoMa) approaches. Translation and rigid models prove insufficient under tissue deformation, while TPS with random sampling achieves the strongest landmark-derived alignment of the evaluated configurations; among the learned matchers, used without fine-tuning, only RoMa offers a robust, if modest, advantage over other methods. At the sequence level, pairwise registration quality proved an unreliable predictor of final mosaic quality, so mosaic quality must be evaluated directly rather than inferred from pairwise metrics.

AI.title_translation: pCLE马赛克配准变换模型的评估
AI.tldr: 通过人工标注的landmark数据集和几何误差（TRE）评估，本文发现薄板样条（TPS）模型在pCLE图像拼接中表现最佳，且成对配准质量不能直接反映最终拼接效果。
AI.motivation: 由于pCLE逐行采集及探头运动，帧对齐通常需要非线性变换，但传统基于外观的指标（如NCC）易受噪声和强度特征误导，无法真实反映几何精度。因此需要一个基于几何真实标签（TRE）的评估体系来确定最佳的变换模型和匹配方法。
AI.method: 构建了一个包含来自4名患者的132对帧对、带有手动标注对应关系的数据集，用以计算目标配准误差（TRE）；评估了从平移到薄板样条（TPS）的递进自由度变换模型，以及6种经典和深度学习特征匹配后端。
AI.result: 平移和刚体模型在组织形变下表现不足；带随机采样的TPS实现了最强的地标驱动对齐；在未经微调的深度学习匹配器中，仅RoMa展现出微弱但稳健的优势；此外，成对配准质量并非最终拼接质量的可靠预测指标。
AI.conclusion: 在pCLE拼接中，平移和刚性模型无法应对组织形变，采用TPS与随机采样的组合能够实现最佳的几何对齐；同时，成对配准质量不能直接推断最终拼接质量，必须对拼接结果进行直接评估。
AI.translation: 共聚焦激光内镜（CLE）可提供实时的、细胞分辨率的光学活检，但其视场较窄，图像拼接可将其扩展以提供解剖学背景。由于逐行采集、探头运动以及探头与组织的相互作用，帧对齐通常需要非线性变换，且其准确性难以量化：灵活的变换模型可以拟合强度特征和噪声，因此诸如归一化互相关（NCC）等基于外观的指标可能会在几何准确性没有真正提升的情况下有所改善。因此，我们建立了一个包含来自4名患者的14个pCLE序列中的132对帧对的数据集，其中包含手动标注的地标对应关系，以便目标配准误差（TRE）可以作为NCC的几何接地补充。我们评估了逐步增加变换模型自由度的影响（从平移到薄板样条（TPS）），以及六种跨越经典（Shi-Tomasi、Lucas-Kanade）和学习（SuperPoint、SuperGlue、LightGlue、LoFTR、RoMa）方法的特征匹配后端。在组织形变下，平移模型和刚性模型被证明是不够的，而在评估的配置中，具有随机采样的TPS实现了最强的地标驱动对齐；在未经微调的学习匹配器中，只有RoMa比其他方法提供了一个稳健但 modest 的优势。在序列水平上，成对配准质量被证明是最终马赛克质量的不可靠预测指标，因此必须直接评估马赛克质量，而不是从成对指标中推断。
AI.summary: 本文评估了用于pCLE马赛克配准的多种变换模型与特征匹配方法。通过构建包含人工标注landmark的数据集，研究人员利用目标配准误差（TRE）作为几何指标，发现自由度较高的薄板样条（TPS）模型表现最佳，而基于外观的成对指标不能有效预测最终的拼接质量。
AI.keywords: pCLE, 图像配准, 变换模型, 目标配准误差, 特征匹配
AI.comments: 本文针对pCLE图像拼接中的变换模型和特征匹配方法进行了系统评估，创新性地引入了人工标注的特征点集及目标配准误差（TRE），以解决传统基于外观的指标（如NCC）无法准确反映几何精度的痛点。对临床内镜图像处理具有重要的参考价值。

title: ARSTAG: An Agentic Real2Sim2Real System for Task-Specific Robot Data Generation
comments: 12 pages, 15 figures and tables. Project webpage: https://boweili666.github.io/ARSTAG/
summary: Adapting visuomotor policies to new manipulation tasks often requires substantial manual engineering or teleoperated data collection. Simulation can provide task-specific data at scale, but constructing the scene, designing expert behavior, and configuring data generation still require significant per-task effort. We present ARSTAG, an agentic Real2Sim2Real system that turns a single RGB image and a natural-language instruction directly into robot policy-learning data. A hierarchy of language agents constructs a task-scoped simulation scene, generates robot-feasible demonstrations, and expands the training distribution through task-consistent randomization, while a coordinator agent manages cross-stage feedback and recovery. Across seven manipulation tasks spanning grasping, placement, and stacking, the ARSTAG-generated demonstrations enable sim-to-real transfer of three visuomotor policy architectures to a dual-arm robot, with pi0.5 achieving an average real-world success rate of 74.6%. Ablations show that task-consistent randomization substantially improves robustness, and policy performance increases with generated dataset size. Project webpage: https://boweili666.github.io/ARSTAG/.
comment: 12 pages, 15 figures and tables. Project webpage: https://boweili666.github.io/ARSTAG/

AI.title_translation: ARSTAG：用于特定任务机器人数据生成的智能体式Real2Sim2Real系统
AI.tldr: 提出了一种名为ARSTAG的智能体系统，仅凭单张RGB图像和语言指令即可自动生成机器人策略学习数据，实现了高效的仿真到真实世界迁移。
AI.motivation: 适应新操作任务的视觉运动策略通常需要大量的M手工工程或遥操作数据收集，而传统的仿真数据生成在构建场景、设计专家行为和配置数据时仍需要大量的人力成本。
AI.method: 利用分层语言智能体构建任务范围内的仿真场景、生成机器人可行的示范，并通过任务一致的随机化扩展训练分布，同时由一个协调员智能体管理跨阶段的反馈和恢复。
AI.result: 在涵盖抓取、放置和堆叠的七个操作任务中，ARSTAG生成的示范成功实现了三种视觉运动策略架构向双臂机器人的仿真到现实世界迁移，其中 pi0.5 的平均现实世界成功率达到了 74.6%。
AI.conclusion: ARSTAG通过分层语言智能体成功实现了从单张RGB图像和语言指令到机器人策略训练数据的全自动生成，并在双臂机器人上验证了其出色的仿真到真实世界的迁移能力。
AI.translation: 将视觉运动策略适应于新的操作任务通常需要大量的手工工程或遥操作数据收集。仿真可以大规模提供特定任务的数据，但构建场景、设计专家行为以及配置数据生成仍然需要大量针对每个任务的努力。我们提出了 ARSTAG，一个智能体式的 Real2Sim2Real 系统，它能将单张 RGB 图像和自然语言指令直接转化为机器人策略学习数据。一组层级化的语言智能体会构建一个局限于任务的仿真场景，生成机器人可行的示范，并通过任务一致的随机化扩展训练分布，同时一个协调员智能体负责管理跨阶段的反馈和恢复。在涵盖抓取、放置和 stacking（堆叠）的七个操作任务中，ARSTAG 生成的示范使得三种视觉运动策略架构能够成功迁移到双臂机器人的现实世界中，其中 pi0.5 实现了 74.6% 的平均现实世界成功率。消融实验表明，任务一致的随机化显著提高了鲁棒性，并且策略性能随着生成数据集大小的增加而提升。项目网页：https://boweili666.github.io/ARSTAG/。
AI.summary: 本文提出了ARSTAG，一个基于智能体的Real2Sim2Real系统，能够仅凭单张RGB图像和自然语言指令自动生成特定任务的机器人策略学习数据。通过分层语言智能体和协调员智能体的配合，该系统完成了场景构建、示范生成和随机化扩展，并在真实的双臂机器人上验证了其有效性。
AI.keywords: 智能体, Real2Sim2Real, 机器人数据生成, 视觉运动策略, 仿真到真实迁移
AI.comments: 该论文创新性地提出了一种基于智能体的Real2Sim2Real系统ARSTAG，仅需单张RGB图像和自然语言指令即可自动生成特定任务的机器人策略学习数据，大大降低了手动工程和遥操作数据收集的高昂成本，在多项操作任务中展现了出色的现实世界迁移性能。

title: HyperCLIP++: Fine-tuning CLIP forOpen-vocabulary Semantic Segmentation in Hyperbolic Space
summary: CLIP, a foundational vision-language model, has emerged as a powerful tool for open-vocabulary semantic segmentation. While freezing CLIP's text encoder is known to preserve its generalization capability, recent studies show that fine-tuning both CLIP's text and image encoders jointly significantly enhances segmentation performance, especially for classes from open sets. In this work, we explain this phenomenon from the perspective of hierarchy alignment, since during fine-tuning, the hierarchical level of image embeddings shifts from image-level to pixel-level. We achieve this by leveraging hyperbolic space, which naturally encodes hierarchical structures. Our key observation is that, during fine-tuning, the hyperbolic radius of CLIP's text embeddings decreases, facilitating better alignment with the pixel-level granularity of visual data. Building on this, we propose HyperCLIP++, a novel and parameter-efficient adaptation strategy. HyperCLIP++ directly adjusts the hyperbolic radius of CLIP's embeddings via scaling transformations to achieve a hierarchy alignment to the target task, i.e., segmentation. To ensure this hierarchy alignment is effected consistently across both modalities and preserves their cross-modal alignment during training, HyperCLIP++ integrates a Dual Cross-Relation Communication (DCRC) module that synchronizes these adjustments between the vision and text pathways. Our experiments show that HyperCLIP++ achieves state-of-the-art performance across three benchmarks while fine-tuning only approximately 5% of CLIP's total parameters. More importantly, we observe that after adjustment, CLIP's text embeddings exhibit a relatively fixed hyperbolic radius across datasets, suggesting that the hierarchical level required for this segmentation task might be quantified using the hyperbolic radius.

AI.title_translation: HyperCLIP++：在双曲空间中微调CLIP用于开放词汇语义分割
AI.tldr: 本文提出了HyperCLIP++，通过在双曲空间中调整CLIP嵌入的半径来实现语义分割任务中的层次对齐，仅需微调少量参数即可达到最先进的性能。
AI.motivation: 现有研究表明微调CLIP的文本和图像编码器可以显著增强开放词汇语义分割性能，但缺乏理论解释；本文旨在从层次对齐的角度解释这一现象，并开发一种参数高效的适应策略。
AI.method: 利用双曲空间天然编码层次结构的特性，通过缩放变换直接调整CLIP嵌入的双曲半径来实现层次对齐，并引入双跨关系通信（DCRC）模块在训练中同步视觉和文本路径的调整。
AI.result: 实验表明，HyperCLIP++在三个基准测试上实现了最先进的性能，同时仅微调了CLIP大约5%的总参数。
AI.conclusion: HyperCLIP++通过双曲空间建模和半径调整，有效实现了CLIP模型在开放词汇语义分割任务中的层次对齐，在保持跨模态对齐的同时显著提升了分割性能。
AI.translation: CLIP作为一种基础的视觉-语言模型，已成为开放词汇语义分割的强大工具。虽然冻结CLIP的文本编码器已知可以保持其泛化能力，但最新研究表明，联合微调CLIP的文本和图像编码器可以显著提升分割性能，特别是对于开放集中的类别。在这项工作中，我们从层次对齐的角度解释了这一现象，因为在微调过程中，图像嵌入的层次水平从图像级转移到了像素级。我们通过利用自然编码层次结构的双曲空间来实现这一点。我们的关键观察是，在微调过程中，CLIP文本嵌入的双曲半径减小，这促进了与视觉数据像素级粒度的更好对齐。基于此，我们提出了HyperCLIP++，这是一种新颖且参数高效的适应策略。HyperCLIP++通过缩放变换直接调整CLIP嵌入的双曲半径，以实现对目标任务（即分割）的层次对齐。为了确保这种层次 alignment 在两个模态之间一致生效并在训练期间保持其跨模态对齐，HyperCLIP++集成了一个双跨关系通信（DCRC）模块，用于在视觉和文本路径之间同步这些调整。我们的实验表明，HyperCLIP++在三个基准测试中实现了最先进的性能，同时仅微调了CLIP总参数的大约5%。更重要的是，我们观察到调整后，CLIP的文本 embeddings 在不同数据集上表现出相对固定的双曲半径，这表明该分割任务所需的层次水平可以通过双曲半径来量化。
AI.summary: 本文提出了HyperCLIP++，一种用于开放词汇语义分割的双曲空间CLIP微调方法。通过研究微调过程中的层次对齐现象，该方法利用双曲空间调整CLIP嵌入的半径，并结合双跨关系通信模块同步模态调整，在大幅减少微调参数的同时取得了最先进的分割性能。
AI.keywords: HyperCLIP++, 开放词汇语义分割, 双曲空间, 层次对齐, CLIP微调
AI.comments: 该论文创新性地将双曲空间引入CLIP模型的微调中，从层次对齐的角度解释了图像-像素级任务中CLIP微调的有效性，并提出了参数高效的HyperCLIP++方法，具有很高的理论和实际价值。

title: Active Visual Sampling with a Connectome-Constrained Fly Model for One-Shot Hatch Recognition in Architectural Drawings
summary: Architectural drawings encode material classes through repeated hatch patterns. We test whether a connectome-constrained fly visual network, pretrained for motion, can be repurposed without task-specific weight updates as a descriptor for one-shot hatch matching. Each 64 x 64 patch is translated over eight scan trajectories and summarized across 57 cell types; query descriptors are then matched to one legend strip per class. On 400 development sheets from a synthetic benchmark built on CubiCasa5K geometry, the frozen fly pipeline reaches 0.857 area-weighted accuracy and 0.910 with an extended legend. On an equal-brightness orientation condition it reaches 0.840 versus 0.299 for eleven pixel statistics, while a Gabor bank reaches 0.900. Replacing drift with a repeated still frame lowers the combined equal-condition score by 0.089 [0.066, 0.112]. However, a receptors-only descriptor reaches 0.891 and a task-trained 5,888-parameter CNN averages 0.959, so the current evidence supports transfer and the usefulness of active sampling, but not an advantage of the biological wiring. We separate project-recorded results from recomputed checks and report a small real-drawing audit. The supported claim is therefore narrow: motion-oriented biological vision can be repurposed as a useful texture representation for architectural hatch matching, while the topology contribution and end-to-end BIM utility remain open questions.

AI.title_translation: 基于连接组约束果蝇模型的主动视觉采样用于建筑图纸中的单样本填充识别
AI.tldr: 利用预训练的果蝇视觉模型进行建筑图纸填充图案识别，证明了运动导向生物视觉可迁移用于纹理匹配，但其生物拓扑结构的独特优势尚未得到证实。
AI.motivation: 测试一个预训练用于运动的、受连接组约束的果蝇视觉网络，在不需要特定任务权重更新的情况下，是否可以作为单样本填充图案匹配的描述符。
AI.method: 将64x64的图像块沿着八条扫描轨迹平移，并通过57种细胞类型进行总结；然后将查询描述符与每类的一个图例条目进行匹配。评估了冻结的果蝇视觉网络管道、扩展图例、像素统计、Gabor滤波器组以及小型CNN。
AI.result: 在400个合成基准图纸上，冻结的果蝇管道达到了0.857的面积加权准确率（扩展图例为0.910）；在等亮度方向条件下达到0.840（11种像素统计为0.299，Gabor滤波器组为0.900）；然而，仅有感受器的描述符达到了0.891，而经过任务训练的5,888参数CNN平均达到了0.959。
AI.conclusion: 运动导向的生物视觉可以重新用作建筑填充图案匹配的有用纹理表示，但其拓扑结构的优势和端到端BIM效用仍是开放性问题。
AI.translation: 建筑图纸通过重复的填充图案编码材料类别。我们测试了预训练用于运动的、受连接组约束的果蝇视觉网络在不需要特定任务权重更新的情况下，是否可以重新用作单样本填充匹配的描述符。每个 64 x 64 的图块在八个扫描轨迹上进行平移，并在 57 种细胞类型中进行总结；然后将查询描述符与每类的一个图例条目进行匹配。在基于 CubiCasa5K 几何形状构建的合成基准的 400 个开发图纸上，冻结的果蝇管道达到了 0.857 的面积加权准确率，使用扩展图例时达到了 0.910。在等亮度方向条件下，它达到了 0.840，而十一种像素统计数据为 0.299，Gabor 滤波器组达到了 0.900。用重复的静态帧替代漂移会使组合相等条件得分降低 0.089 [0.066, 0.112]。然而，仅感受器的描述符达到了 0.891，经过任务训练的 5,888 参数 CNN 平均达到了 0.959，因此当前证据支持迁移能力以及主动采样有用性，但不支持生物布线的优势。我们将项目记录的结果与重新计算的检查分开，并报告了小型真实图纸审计。因此，支持的声明是狭隘的：运动导向的生物视觉可以被重新用作建筑填充匹配的有用纹理表示，而拓扑贡献和端到端 BIM 效用仍然是开放性问题。
AI.summary: 该论文研究了将连接组约束的果蝇视觉模型作为描述符，用于建筑图纸中单样本填充图案识别的可行性。通过主动视觉采样和多轨迹扫描，该冻结网络展现出良好的纹理匹配能力，但对比实验表明其生物拓扑结构的优势并不明显。
AI.keywords: 主动视觉采样, 神经连接组, 建筑图纸, 纹理匹配, 生物启发视觉
AI.comments: 该论文巧妙地将基于连接组约束的果蝇视觉模型（针对运动预训练）应用于建筑图纸中的单样本填充图案识别。虽然实验表明这种冻结的生物视觉网络能够很好地提取纹理特征并支持主动视觉采样，但对比实验发现其复杂的生物拓扑结构并没有显著优于简单的感受器描述符或小型CNN，这为探讨生物启发式AI模型的实际优势提供了严谨的实证和反思。

title: Threshold Saturation from a Bounded Region in Multidimensional Spatially Coupled Codes over the BEC
summary: We prove that a bounded shortened region initiates decoding throughout multidimensional spatially coupled regular LDPC and MacKay--Neal (MN) codes over the binary erasure channel (BEC). In every fixed finite dimension, uniform hypercube coupling permits the coupling width and shortened region to be chosen independently of the total number $V$ of spatial positions. At fixed widths and dimension $d>1$, replacing a shortened slab by a bounded hypercube reduces the shortening fraction from order $V^{-1/d}$ to order $V^{-1}$, with the same improvement in the shortening term of the check-count rate bound. Regular LDPC codes decode below their uncoupled potential threshold. MN codes achieve capacity for every integer degree choice $\ell>r\geq2$, $g\geq2$: their actual transmitted rates tend to $r/\ell$ and their average bit-erasure probabilities under sum-product decoding vanish below $1-r/\ell$. The proof combines an endpoint-potential identity, removal of an auxiliary constraint, finite-time estimates uniform in direction, and a curvature comparison that transfers flat-boundary progress to expanding balls. For MN codes, elementary inequalities establish fixed-point positivity for all these degrees. Two-dimensional density-evolution examples illustrate the dependence on the initial shortened region; the general sufficient constants are not evaluated numerically.

title: Poisson Exchange Beyond Submodularity: Effective Approximation Algorithms for Offline and Online Subset Selection over Matroids
summary: Over the past decade, a growing body of research has shown that $γ$-weak submodularity broadly arises in numerous subset selection tasks, including feature selection, neural network pruning, and video summarization. Despite its prevalence, maximizing a $γ$-weakly submodular function subject to a general matroid constraint remains challenging. To date, the only known approximation guarantee is the conservative $(1+1/γ)^{-2}$ factor established by \citet{chen2018weakly}. To improve upon this result, this paper proposes a novel algorithm called \MGPE, which repeatedly performs maximum-gain local exchanges through careful control of a non-homogeneous Poisson clock, and proves that this \MGPE\ can attain an approximation ratio arbitrarily close to $ρ_γ=1-\left(γ/(2-γ)\right)^{ \frac{γ^2}{2(1-γ)} }$. In sharp contrast to the previous guarantee, our obtained factor $ρ_γ$ not only strictly improves upon $(1+1/γ)^{-2}$ for every $γ\in(0,1]$, but also can asymptotically approach the optimal $(1-1/e)$-approximation for submodular maximization as $γ\to1$. Furthermore, we surprisingly find that when the matroid constraint reduces to a cardinality or the objective satisfies the stronger notion of $α$-weak DR-submodularity, \MGPE\ can automatically recover the tight approximation ratios of $1-e^{-γ}$ and $1-e^{-α}$, respectively. Here, $α\in(0,1]$ denotes the DR ratio.

AI.title_translation: 超越次模性的泊松交换：拟阵约束下离线和在线子集选择的高效近似算法
AI.tldr: 提出了一种新颖的泊松交换算法（MGPE），显著改进了拟阵约束下弱次模子集选择问题的理论近似保证。
AI.motivation: 在许多子集选择任务中广泛存在的$\gamma$-弱次模函数最大化问题在一般拟阵约束下仍然充满挑战，此前已知的最好近似保证较为保守，亟需改进。
AI.method: 提出了一种名为MGPE的新算法，通过精确控制非齐次泊松时钟来重复执行最大增益局部交换。
AI.result: MGPE算法达到了任意接近 $\rho_\gamma=1-\left(\gamma/(2-\gamma)\right)^{\frac{\gamma^2}{2(1-\gamma)}}$ 的近似比，严格改进了先前的结果，并且在退化为基数约束或满足更强的 $\alpha$-弱 DR-次模性时能够自动恢复紧密的近似比。
AI.conclusion: 论文提出了MGPE算法，在离线和在线拟阵约束下有效最大化弱次模函数，实现了优于以往研究的理论近似保证，并能自适应特殊情况。
AI.translation: 在过去的十年里，越来越多的研究表明，$\gamma$-弱次模性广泛出现在许多子集选择任务中，包括特征选择、神经网络剪枝和视频摘要。尽管它很普遍，但在一般拟阵约束下最大化一个 $\gamma$-弱次模函数仍然具有挑战性。迄今为止，唯一已知的近似保证是 \citet{chen2018weakly} 建立的保守的 $(1+1/\gamma)^{-2}$ 因子。为了改进这一结果，本文提出了一种名为 \MGPE 的新算法，该算法通过仔细控制非齐次泊松时钟来重复执行最大增益局部交换，并证明了该 \MGPE 可以获得任意接近 $\rho_\gamma=1-\left(\gamma/(2-\gamma)\right)^{ \frac{\gamma^2}{2(1-γ)} }$ 的近似比。与先前的保证形成鲜明对比的是，我们获得的因子 $\rho_\gamma$ 不仅对每个 $\gamma\in(0,1]$ 都严格改进了 $(1+1/\gamma)^{-2}$，而且随着 $\gamma\to1$ 还可以渐近接近次模最大化的最优 $(1-1/e)$ 近似。此外，我们惊讶地发现，当拟阵约束简化为基数约束或目标满足更强的 $\alpha$-弱 DR-次模性概念时，\MGPE 可以自动分别恢复 $1-e^{-\gamma}$ 和 $1-e^{-\alpha}$ 的紧密近似比。这里，$\alpha\in(0,1]$ 表示 DR 比率。
AI.summary: 本文研究了拟阵约束下的 $\gamma$-弱次模函数最大化问题，提出了一种名为MGPE的新型有效近似算法。通过控制非齐次泊松时钟执行最大增益局部交换，该算法在理论上取得了严格优于以往研究的近似比，并在特殊约束或目标函数下能够自适应恢复最优或紧密的近似界。
AI.keywords: 弱次模性, 拟阵约束, 子集选择, 泊松交换, 近似算法
AI.comments: 该论文突破了传统次模性限制，提出了一种基于非齐次泊松时钟的新颖算法（MGPE），在拟阵约束下的弱次模子集选择问题中实现了显著改进的近似比，具有重要的理论意义和广泛的应用潜力。

title: Evaluating Decision Models for Text Annotation in Computational Social Science
summary: Computational social science increasingly relies on large language models for text annotation, and the validity of published findings now rests on the labels generated by such models. Decision models, a new model class built for categorical question answering, answer typed questions with a choice, a probability distribution over the label set, and a confidence score rather than free text, at a small fraction of frontier inference prices. Whether their answers are accurate, and whether that stated confidence can be trusted on social science constructs, are unknown. Here, we mirror the evaluation of Ziems et al. (2024) on 18 computational social science classification tasks (7,977 items), comparing the first commercial decision model and two open-weight counterparts against 19 frontier and open-weight language models under the same zero-shot protocol. The decision model trails the per-task best LLM on 14 of 15 evaluation tasks, with a median deficit of 11.6 macro-F1 points, at a median 44 times lower measured cost. Its confidence is better calibrated than the verbalized confidence of 16 of the 19 LLMs, yet three frontier models show lower median calibration error (0.157 against 0.066). While items above 0.9 confidence are typically labeled accurately (median accuracy 0.815), on one task, empathy in peer-support dialogues, the model reports high confidence while performing near chance. Nonetheless, our results suggest that decision models are useful as a first step in the annotation pipeline: routing low-confidence items to an LLM matches or exceeds the LLM alone at a quarter to half of its cost.

AI.title_translation: 计算社会科学中用于文本标注的决策模型评估
AI.tldr: 决策模型虽然准确率略逊于前沿大模型，但能以极低的成本和良好的置信度校准，作为大模型文本标注流水线的高效前置筛选工具。
AI.motivation: 计算社会科学越来越依赖大语言模型进行文本标注，而新型的“决策模型”专为分类问答设计，成本极低，但其在社会科学构念上的准确性和置信度尚不明确，因此需要对其进行系统评估。
AI.method: 在18个计算社会科学分类任务（7,977个样本）上复制了Ziems等人的评估方法，在零样本协议下对比了1个商业决策模型、2个开源决策模型与19个前沿/开源大语言模型。
AI.result: 决策模型的宏平均F1分数比最佳大模型中位数低11.6个点，但成本降低了约44倍；其置信度校准优于多数大模型，且高置信度（>0.9）样本准确率较高（中位数0.815），但特定任务上仍存在失效风险。将决策模型与大模型结合构建路由流水线，可以在降低50%-75%成本的同时，达到甚至超过单独使用大模型的性能。
AI.conclusion: 决策模型虽然在纯准确率上落后于前沿大模型，但因其低成本和良好的置信度校准，非常适合作为标注流水线的初步筛选工具。
AI.translation: 计算社会科学日益依赖大语言模型进行文本标注，已发表研究结果的有效性现在依赖于此类模型生成的标签。决策模型是一类专为分类问答构建的新模型，它以自由文本的一小部分前沿推理价格，用选择、标签集的概率分布和置信度分数来回答类型化问题。它们的答案是否准确，以及所陈述的置信度是否可以在社会科学构念上被信任，目前尚不得知。在此，我们在18个计算社会科学分类任务（7,977个样本）上镜像了Ziems等人（2024）的评估，在相同的零样本协议下，将第一个商业决策模型和两个开源对应模型与19个前沿和开源大语言模型进行了比较。在15个评估任务中，决策模型在14个任务上落后于每个任务的最佳LLM，宏观F1点数的中位数差距为11.6，而测得的成本中位数低了44倍。其置信度的校准比19个LLM中16个的言语化置信度更好，但三个前沿模型显示出更低的中位校准误差（0.157对0.066）。虽然置信度高于0.9的项目通常被准确标记（中位准确度0.815），但在一个任务（同伴支持对话中的同情心）中，该模型在表现接近随机水平的同时报告了高置信度。尽管如此，我们的结果表明，决策模型作为标注流水线的第一步是有用的：将低置信度项目路由到LLM，可以以其四分之一到一半的成本匹配或超过单独使用LLM的效果。
AI.summary: 本文评估了专门用于分类问答的决策模型在计算社会科学文本标注中的表现。研究发现，尽管决策模型的准确率不及前沿大模型，但其显著更低的成本和更好的置信度校准使其非常适合作为混合标注流水线的初始步骤，通过路由低成本任务来提升整体标注效率。
AI.keywords: 决策模型, 计算社会科学, 文本标注, 大语言模型, 置信度校准
AI.comments: 本文评估了决策模型在计算社会科学文本标注中的性能，揭示了其在准确率上落后于前沿大模型但在成本和置信度校准上的优势，为构建高效、经济的混合标注流水线提供了有价值的参考。

title: Single-Fragment Forensic Coding via Multidimensional Cyclically Permutable Codes
summary:
The proliferation of 3D printing raises new security and forensic challenges, including the risk of unauthorized fabrication of untraceable firearms and other regulated items. To enable traceability, we consider \emph{single-fragment forensic coding}, in which a unique identifier is embedded into a printed object and must be recoverable from any fragment containing an axis-parallel box of prescribed minimum volume and coordinatewise thickness, even in the presence of substitution errors. To address this problem, we introduce and study multidimensional cyclically permutable codes (CPCs), for which every cyclic translate uniquely determines both the original codeword and the applied translation. By applying periodic lifting to a CPC base array, every complete period contained in a fragment corresponds to an unknown cyclic translate of a codeword, thereby reducing the forensic alignment problem to multidimensional cyclic synchronization.
  We establish theoretical bounds and develop explicit constructions in both the noiseless and substitution-error settings. For fixed dimension $d$ and alphabet size $q$, we obtain the optimal redundancy $d\log_q k+o(1)$ for noiseless $d$-dimensional CPCs of side length $k$. For fixed $t$, the optimal redundancy of $t$-substitution-correcting $d$-dimensional CPCs lies between $(t+1)d\log_q k+O(1)$ and $(2t+1)d\log_q k+O(1)$. For binary alphabets and $d\geq2$, an explicit robust row-anchor construction achieves $(t+1)d\log_2 k+O(\log\log k)$ redundancy, matching the optimal leading term. In the thick-fragment regime $h=cM^{1/d}$, where $M$ and $h$ lower-bound the volume and the side lengths of a box contained in the fragment, periodic lifting yields single-fragment forensic codes of rate $c^d-o(1)$. In particular, the rate approaches one when $c=1-o(1)$.

AI.title_translation: 基于多维循环可置换码的单碎片取证编码
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于多维循环可置换码的新型编码方案，能够从3D打印物体的任意碎片中可靠地恢复唯一标识符，从而解决3D打印物品的取证和可追溯性挑战。
AI.motivation: 3D打印的普及引发了未经授权制造无法追踪的枪支和其他受管制物品等安全与取证挑战，为了实现可追溯性，需要开发一种能够从包含规定最小体积和厚度的任意碎片中恢复嵌入唯一标识符的单碎片法医编码技术。
AI.method: 引入并研究了多维循环可置换码（CPCs），通过对CPC基本数组应用周期提升（periodic lifting），将法医对齐问题简化为多维循环同步问题，并建立了理论界限与显式构造。
AI.result: 在固定维度和字母表大小下，得到了无噪声多维CPCs的最优冗余度；对于纠正t个替换错误的情况，给出了冗余度的理论上下界；对于二进制字母表和d≥2，显式的强鲁棒行锚点构造实现了最优的前导项冗余度；在厚碎片区域，周期提升法产生了速率为 c^d - o(1) 的单碎片法医编码。
AI.conclusion: 本文成功通过多维循环可置换码和周期提升技术实现了高效的单碎片法医编码，在无噪声及容错设置下给出了最优的冗余度和显式构造，速率在特定区域逼近于1。
AI.translation:
3D打印的普及带来了新的安全和取证挑战，包括未经授权制造无法追踪的枪支和其他受管制物品的风险。为了实现可追溯性，我们考虑了“单碎片法医编码”，其中唯一标识符被嵌入到打印对象中，并且必须能够从包含规定最小体积和坐标厚度的轴平行盒的任何碎片中恢复，即使在存在替换错误的情况下也是如此。为了解决这个问题，我们引入并研究了多维循环可置换码（CPCs），对于这种编码，每个循环平移都能唯一确定原始码字和所应用的平移。通过将周期提升应用于CPC基本数组，碎片中包含的每个完整周期都对应于码字的未知循环平移，从而将取证对齐问题简化为多维循环同步。
我们在无噪声和替换错误设置下建立了理论界限并开发了显式构造。对于固定的维度 $d$ 和字母表大小 $q$，我们获得了边长为 $k$ 的无噪声 $d$ 维 CPCs 的最优冗余度 $d\log_q k+o(1)$。对于固定的 $t$，纠正 $t$ 个替换错误的多维 CPCs 的最优冗余度介于 $(t+1)d\log_q k+O(1)$ 和 $(2t+1)d\log_q k+O(1)$ 之间。对于二进制字母表和 $d\geq2$，一种显式的鲁棒行锚点构造实现了 $(t+1)d\log_2 k+O(\log\log k)$ 的冗余度，与最优前导项相匹配。在厚碎片区域 $h=cM^{1/d}$（其中 $M$ 和 $h$ 分别下界限制了碎片中所含盒子体积和边长）中，周期提升产生了速率为 $c^d-o(1)$ 的单碎片法医编码。特别是，当 $c=1-o(1)$ 时，速率接近1。
AI.summary: 本文研究了3D打印物体的安全与可追溯性问题，提出了基于多维循环可置换码（CPCs）和周期提升技术的单碎片法医编码方案，能够在存在替换错误的情况下从任意碎片中恢复嵌入的唯一标识符，并给出了理论界限和显式构造。
AI.keywords: 3D打印安全, 取证编码, 多维循环可置换码, 周期同步, 纠错码
AI.comments: 该论文针对3D打印带来的安全和取证挑战，创新性地提出了多维循环可置换码（CPCs）和周期提升技术，成功解决了单碎片法医编码问题，在理论界限和显式构造方面均取得了重要进展。

title: What do VLM-Based Vision-Language Navigation Models Rely on: Interpreting and Steering Policy Behavior
summary: Modern Vision-Language Navigation (VLN) models rely mostly on pre-trained large Vision-Language Models (VLMs) to predict navigation actions. While this fusion of language instructions and visual observations allows multimodal reasoning, it obscures how information is routed across modalities or what mechanisms drive navigation decisions. Thus, it remains unclear whether VLN models ground their predictions in relevant semantic cues or can track task progress. In this work, we study the interpretability and steerability of VLN models. We use intervention-based metrics that measure how visual observations, instructions, and visual memory causally influence navigation decisions. Our results show that these navigation policies are sensitive to all input modalities and do not depend on a single one. We further show that these agents encode navigation progress and retain semantic structure from their VLM backbones, enabling concept-level steering through internal activations. Finally, we extract activation vectors for abstract behaviors to transfer them zero-shot to out-of-distribution real-world scenarios, improving performance without additional fine-tuning.

AI.title_translation: 基于VLM的视觉语言导航模型依赖于什么：解释与引导策略行为
AI.tldr: 本文通过干预性分析揭示了基于VLM的视觉语言导航模型的内部决策机制，证明了其多模态依赖性、任务进度编码能力，并实现了概念级行为引导与零样本迁移。
AI.motivation: 现代基于VLM的VLN模型虽然实现了多模态推理，但其内部信息路由和决策机制尚不明确，因此需要研究其可解释性和可操纵性，以弄清其是否真正基于相关语义线索进行预测并追踪任务进度。
AI.method: 使用基于干预的指标（intervention-based metrics）来测量视觉观测、指令和视觉记忆对导航决策的因果影响，并提取抽象行为的激活向量以实现零样本迁移。
AI.result: 结果表明，导航策略对所有输入模态都很敏感，不依赖于单一模态；代理能够编码导航进度并保留VLM骨干网络的语义结构，从而实现概念级操纵，并且提取的激活向量可零样本迁移到分布外真实场景中以提升性能。
AI.conclusion: 基于VLM的VLN模型对所有输入模态均敏感，能够编码导航进度并保留语义结构，支持通过内部激活进行概念级操纵和零样本行为迁移。
AI.translation: 现代视觉语言导航（VLN）模型主要依赖预训练的大型视觉语言模型（VLM）来预测导航动作。虽然语言指令和视觉观测的这种融合实现了多模态推理，但它掩盖了信息如何在模态间路由或是什么机制驱动了导航决策。因此，VLN模型是否将其预测建立在相关语义线索的基础上或能否跟踪任务进度仍不清楚。在这项工作中，我们研究了VLN模型的可解释性和可操纵性。我们使用基于干预的指标来测量视觉观测、指令和视觉记忆如何因果地影响导航决策。我们的结果表明，这些导航策略对所有输入模态都很敏感，并不依赖于单一模态。我们进一步表明，这些智能体编码了导航进度并保留了其VLM骨干网络的语义结构，从而能够通过内部激活进行概念级操纵。最后，我们提取了抽象行为的激活向量，将其零样本迁移到分布外的真实世界场景中，在无需额外微调的情况下提高了性能。
AI.summary: 本文研究了基于VLM的视觉语言导航（VLN）模型的可解释性和可操纵性。通过干预性指标，研究发现这些模型依赖于多模态输入，能够编码导航进度，并支持通过内部激活进行概念级操纵与零样本行为迁移，从而在无需微调的情况下提升了分布外场景的性能。
AI.keywords: Vision-Language Navigation, Large Vision-Language Models, Interpretability, Steerability, Causal Intervention
AI.comments: 该论文深入探讨了基于大视觉语言模型（VLM）的视觉语言导航（VLN）模型的内部机制，通过干预性指标揭示了其多模态融合、任务进度跟踪以及概念级操纵的能力，对提升VLN模型的可解释性和鲁棒性具有重要意义。

title: Universal Multi-Modal Traceformer: Integrating Heterogeneous Context for Process Event Prediction
summary: Event logs arise in a wide range of real-world processes, capturing not only event activities and timestamps but also multi-modal contextual information. Existing event-sequence models, including many temporal point process approaches, primarily model event activities and timestamps while overlooking heterogeneous context, such as numerical measurements, categorical attributes, textual descriptions, and metadata associated with individual events and entire traces. In this paper, we propose Universal Multi-Modal Traceformer (UMT), a unified framework for incorporating heterogeneous process context into next-event prediction. Built on a Transformer backbone, UMT introduces a universal feature encoder that maps diverse feature types into a shared representation space and handles contextual information at both the event and trace levels. UMT further develops a per-event Perceiver module that dynamically weights contextual features and adaptively integrates them into event-token representations. To accommodate the heavy-tailed and potentially multi-modal distribution of inter-arrival times, UMT represents each interval at multiple temporal scales and jointly predicts the corresponding scale-specific quantities. Experiments on 13 real-world event logs show that UMT improves both next-event activity and time prediction over existing approaches.

AI.title_translation: 通用多模态Traceformer：为过程事件预测集成异构上下文
AI.tldr: 本文提出了Universal Multi-Modal Traceformer (UMT)框架，利用Transformer和Perceiver模块有效整合异构多模态上下文，显著提升了过程事件预测的准确性。
AI.motivation: 现有的事件序列模型（包括许多时间点过程方法）主要对事件活动和时间戳进行建模，而忽视了诸如数值测量、分类属性、文本描述以及与单个事件和整个追踪相关的元数据等异构上下文信息。
AI.method: 基于Transformer骨干网，提出通用特征编码器（将多样化特征映射至共享表示空间并处理事件与追踪级上下文），引入per-event Perceiver模块（动态加权并整合上下文特征），以及采用多时间尺度联合预测到达间隔时间。
AI.result: 在13个真实世界事件日志上的实验表明，UMT在预测下一事件的活动和时间方面均优于现有方法。
AI.conclusion: UMT是一个统一的框架，能够有效地整合过程事件中的异构多模态上下文，从而显著提升下一事件的活动类型和发生时间的预测性能。
AI.translation: 事件日志广泛存在于各类真实世界的业务过程中，不仅记录了事件活动和时间戳，还捕捉了多模态的上下文信息。现有的事件序列模型（包括许多时间点过程方法）主要对事件活动和时间戳进行建模，而忽略了异构上下文，例如与单个事件和整个追踪相关的数值测量、分类属性、文本描述和元数据。在本文中，我们提出了通用多模态Traceformer（UMT），这是一个将异构过程上下文集成到下一事件预测中的统一框架。建立在Transformer骨干网基础之上，UMT引入了一个通用特征编码器，将不同的特征类型映射到共享的表示空间，并处理事件级和追踪级的上下文信息。UMT进一步开发了一个逐事件的Perceiver模块，用于动态加权上下文特征并将其自适应地集成到事件标记表示中。为了适应到达间隔时间的重尾且可能是多模态的分布，UMT在多个时间尺度上表示每个时间间隔，并联合预测相应的特定尺度量。在13个真实世界事件日志上的实验表明，与现有方法相比，UMT改进了下一事件的活动和时间预测。
AI.summary: 本文提出了通用多模态Traceformer (UMT)，这是一个旨在将异构过程上下文整合到下一事件预测中的统一框架。UMT利用Transformer架构、通用特征编码器、Perceiver模块以及多时间尺度间隔表示，有效结合了多模态数据，并在多个真实数据集上取得了优于现有方法的预测性能。
AI.keywords: 过程事件预测, 多模态上下文, Transformer, 异构特征, 时间点过程
AI.comments: 该论文针对过程事件预测中多模态异构上下文处理不足的问题，提出了Universal Multi-Modal Traceformer (UMT)统一框架。其创新点在于通过通用特征编码器和Perceiver模块实现了对事件级与追踪级、多种异构数据类型的统一建模，并在时间预测上采用了多时间尺度的处理方式。实验在13个真实日志上验证了其有效性，具有很高的实用价值。

title: Optimal Allocation of Grid-Forming Frequency Shaping Control
summary: Various inverter-based control strategies have been proposed to improve frequency security for power systems with high renewable penetration. Among them, the grid-forming frequency shaping control is particularly promising due to its ability to shape the post-contingency aggregate system frequency dynamics into first-order with prescribed rate of change of frequency (RoCoF) and steady-state frequency deviation. Moreover, the shaped aggregate dynamics depends on the harmonic sum of all inverter transfer functions rather than on their distribution. In light of this, here we explore how to allocate shaping control resources to minimize the transient control effort needed to achieve ideal coherent dynamics. We formulate it as a constrained optimization problem by tackling two main difficulties. First, we make the squared $\mathcal{H}_2$ norm legitimate quantification of transient control cost under step power imbalances through a system transformation. Second, we simplify the $s$-domain constraint for Nadir elimination into a standard constraint that is easy to implement in optimization. The resulting non-convex optimization problem can be solved by existing successive convexification method. The effectiveness of the allocation has been verified on the modified Icelandic Power Network test case.

AI.title_translation: 构网型频率整形控制的最优分配
AI.tldr: 论文提出了一种优化配置构网型变流器频率整形控制资源的方法，以最小化暂态控制成本并确保系统频率安全性。
AI.motivation: 随着电力系统中可再生能源渗透率的提高，需要各种逆变器控制策略来改善频率安全性。构网型频率整形控制由于能够将系统频率动态塑造为具有规定变化率和稳态偏差的一阶动态而备受关注。然而，如何优化分配这些整形控制资源以最小化实现理想相干动态所需的暂态控制成本，目前尚待解决。
AI.method: 通过系统变换使平方 $\mathcal{H}_2$ 范数成为阶跃功率不平衡下暂态控制成本的合理解定量；将 Nadir 消除的 $s$ 域约束简化为易于在优化中实现的标准约束；采用现有的连续凸化方法求解非凸优化问题。
AI.result: 成功建立了一个受约束的优化问题模型，并能通过现有的连续凸化方法求解，最后在修改后的冰岛电力网络测试案例中验证了该分配方法的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 论文成功提出了一种最优分配构网型频率整形控制资源的框架，并通过冰岛电力网络测试案例验证了其有效性。
AI.translation: 各种基于逆变器的控制策略已被提出来提高高可再生能源渗透率电力系统的频率安全性。其中，构网型频率整形控制由于能够将突发故障后的总体系统频率动态塑造为具有规定变化率（RoCoF）和稳态频率偏差的一阶动态而特别有前景。此外，塑造后的总体动态取决于所有逆变器传递函数的调和平均和，而不是它们的分布。有鉴于此，本文探讨了如何分配整形控制资源，以最小化实现理想相干动态所需的暂态控制成本。我们通过克服两个主要困难将其表述为一个约束优化问题：首先，通过系统变换，使平方 $\mathcal{H}_2$ 范数成为阶跃功率不平衡下暂态控制成本的合理量化；其次，将消除 Nadir（频率最低点）的 $s$ 域约束简化为易于在优化中实施的标准约束。由此产生的非凸优化问题可以通过现有的连续凸化方法求解。该分配方法的有效性已在修改后的冰岛电力网络测试案例中得到了验证。
AI.summary: 论文研究了高比例新能源电力系统下构网型频率整形控制资源的最优分配问题。通过提出系统变换与约束简化方法，将非凸优化问题转化为可利用现有连续凸化方法求解的问题，并在冰岛电力网络中验证了其有效性。
AI.keywords: 构网型变流器, 频率整形控制, 资源分配, 优化问题, 暂态控制成本
AI.comments: 该论文针对高比例新能源电力系统，提出了一种优化配置构网型变流器频率整形控制资源的方法。创新点在于通过系统变换将暂态控制成本转化为平方 $\mathcal{H}_2$ 范数，并简化了 Nadir 消除的 $s$ 域约束，具有较强的工程应用价值。

title: Overlay\_dx - Automating forecasting evaluation
summary: Traditional evaluation metrics provides numerical values but often lack comprehensibility, hindering effective differentiation of model performances. Our work addresses this challenge by introducing overlay\_dx, a novel evaluation metric measuring the performance of time series prediction models. Overlay\_dx is a visual metric that represents the percentage of predictions falling within a confidence interval around actual values. Additionally, once evaluation results are plotted, overlay\_dx computes the area under the overlay curve, providing a quantitative measure of alignment between predicted and actual values across different thresholds and predictions. Through extensive experiments, we demonstrate that our approach offers a unified evaluation framework that combines both visual and numerical assessments, enabling improved model comparison and providing valuable insights for further research and optimization efforts in time series prediction.

AI.title_translation: Overlay_dx：自动化预测评估
AI.tldr: Overlay_dx是一个结合了可视化和数值评估的时间序列预测新指标，通过计算置信区间内的预测占比及覆盖曲线下面积，提升了模型评估的可理解性与有效性。
AI.motivation: 传统评估指标仅提供数值且缺乏可解释性，阻碍了对模型性能的有效区分，因此需要一种更直观、更具综合性的评估框架。
AI.method: 引入overlay_dx指标，该指标计算预测值落在实际值置信区间内的百分比作为视觉指标，并在绘制评估结果后计算覆盖曲线下的面积，从而提供跨越不同阈值和预测的定量度量。
AI.result: 广泛的实验表明，该方法提供了一个统一的评估框架，结合了视觉和数值评估，能够改善模型比较并为时间序列预测的研究与优化提供有价值的见解。
AI.conclusion: Overlay_dx作为一个统一的评估框架，成功地将可视化与数值评估结合起来，为时间序列预测模型的比较和优化提供了强有力的支持。
AI.translation: 传统的评估指标提供数值，但往往缺乏可理解性，阻碍了对模型性能的有效区分。我们的工作通过引入overlay_dx来应对这一挑战，这是一种衡量时间序列预测模型性能的新颖评估指标。Overlay_dx是一个可视指标，表示落在实际值周围置信区间内的预测百分比。此外，一旦绘制了评估结果，overlay_dx就会计算覆盖曲线下的面积，从而提供不同阈值和预测之间预测值与实际值对齐的定量度量。通过广泛的实验，我们证明了我们的方法提供了一个统一的评估框架，结合了视觉和数值评估，能够改善模型比较，并为时间序列预测的进一步研究和优化工作提供有价值的见解。
AI.summary: Overlay_dx是一种新颖的时间序列预测评估指标，它通过结合落在置信区间内的预测百分比这一视觉指标以及覆盖曲线下的面积这一定量度量，提供了一个统一的评估框架，从而增强了模型性能评估的可理解性和可比性。
AI.keywords: 时间序列预测, 评估指标, 可视化评估, 模型比较, 预测准确性
AI.comments: 该论文提出了一种结合可视化与数值评估的新颖时间序列预测评估指标，创新性强且易于理解，有助于解决传统指标可解释性不足的问题。

title: Taking a Second Look: Correcting Sea Ice Forecasts with Sparse Observations
summary: Sea ice forecasts are issued several days ahead, allowing errors to accumulate while new, often sparse sea ice concentration (SIC) observations become available. We find that fixed-propagation errors concentrate near structured, high-gradient ice edges, whereas homogeneous interiors require limited propagation, suggesting that propagation distance should be state dependent. We therefore introduce ECHO (Evidence-guided Correction with Heterogeneous prOpagation), where ECHO-Scale adapts propagation distance while preserving correction geometry, and ECHO-Delta learns a bounded residual around fixed propagation. Across all 96 standard evaluation settings spanning diverse priors, observation times, sparsity levels, geometries, and noise conditions, both outperform fixed propagation. ECHO-Delta achieves the best average accuracy, while ECHO-Scale is more robust to geometry shifts. Code is available at https://github.com/yingtian22/TAKING-A-SECOND-LOOK.

AI.title_translation: 再次审视：利用稀疏观测修正海冰预报
AI.tldr: 提出了一种基于稀疏观测的海冰预报修正框架ECHO，通过状态依赖的异构传播显著提高了海冰浓度预报的准确性。
AI.motivation: 海冰预报在发布几天后会积累误差，而在此期间会有新的、通常较稀疏的海冰浓度（SIC）观测数据可用，因此需要利用这些稀疏观测来校正预报。
AI.method: 引入了ECHO（Evidence-guided Correction with Heterogeneous prOpaganaion）框架，包含ECHO-Scale（自适应传播距离并保持修正几何形状）和ECHO-Delta（在固定传播周围学习有界残差）两种变体。
AI.result: 在跨越各种先验、观测时间、稀疏度水平、几何形状和噪声条件的96个标准评估设置中，ECHO的两个变体均优于传统固定传播；其中ECHO-Delta平均准确率最高，ECHO-Scale对几何形状变化更具稳健性。
AI.conclusion: ECHO框架通过自适应传播距离和残差学习，显著改善了稀疏观测下的海冰预报准确性，并在稳健性和泛化能力方面表现出色。
AI.translation: 海冰预报通常提前数天发布，在此期间误差不断累积，而新的、通常较为稀疏的海冰浓度（SIC）观测数据也随之可用。我们发现，固定的传播误差集中在结构化的、高梯度的冰缘附近，而同质的内部则需要有限的传播，这表明传播距离应该是状态依赖的。因此，我们引入了ECHO（Evidence-guided Correction with Heterogeneous prOpagation，基于证据指导的异构传播修正），其中ECHO-Scale在保持修正几何形状的同时调整传播距离，而ECHO-Delta则在固定传播周围学习有界残差。在涵盖各种先验、观测时间、稀疏度水平、几何形状和噪声条件的全部96个标准评估设置中，两者的表现均优于固定传播。ECHO-Delta实现了最佳的平均准确率，而ECHO-Scale对几何形状的变化更具稳健性。代码可在 https://github.com/yingtian22/TAKING-A-SECOND-LOOK 获取。
AI.summary: 该论文针对海冰预报中的误差积累问题，提出了ECHO（Evidence-guided Correction with Heterogeneous prOpagation）框架，通过利用稀疏的海冰观测数据进行异构传播修正，显著提升了海冰预报的准确性和稳健性。
AI.keywords: 海冰预报, 稀疏观测, 误差修正, 异构传播, 状态依赖
AI.comments: 该论文提出了一种新颖的基于证据指导的异构传播海冰预报修正方法，有效解决了稀疏观测数据下的海冰浓度预报误差积累问题。该方法在多个评估设置中表现出优于固定传播的性能，具有很高的实用价值和理论创新性。

title: Deterministic Smoothed MAP Detection for High-Dimensional MIMO Systems
summary: We propose a deterministic smoothed maximum a posteriori (SMAP) framework for high-dimensional multiple-input multiple-output (MIMO) detection. The discrete constellation prior is approximated by an i.i.d. Gaussian mixture, yielding a differentiable MAP objective that retains the constellation structure while enabling continuous optimization. Unlike sampling-based approaches, SMAP formulates detection as a deterministic optimization problem and can be initialized by the output of an arbitrary detector, allowing it to operate either as a standalone detector or as a refinement stage. For hard detection, we introduce SMAP-KR, which complements the continuous solution with a local $K_R$-neighbor search evaluated according to the original maximum-likelihood metric. Annealed continuation improves robustness for higher-order constellations, while a two-neighbor approximation reduces the cost of evaluating the mixture prior. We further develop a soft-output SMAP method in which a local Gaussian approximation based on the curvature of the smoothed posterior provides symbol probabilities and bit log-likelihood ratios without posterior sampling or explicit counterhypothesis lists. Numerical results for critically loaded MU-MIMO systems show that SMAP-KR provides an increasingly favorable performance-complexity tradeoff as the system dimension grows and can also effectively refine the output of existing detectors. For coded transmission, soft SMAP provides substantial block-error-rate gains over both LMMSE- and K-best-based soft detection.

AI.title_translation: 高维MIMO系统的确定性平滑MAP检测
AI.tldr: 提出了一种基于确定性平滑MAP的高维MIMO系统检测框架，通过高斯混合先验和连续优化实现了卓越的硬/软检测性能与复杂度折衷。
AI.motivation: 高维MIMO系统中的检测面临高计算复杂度和性能权衡的挑战，现有的采样方法或传统检测器在处理高阶星座和高维系统时存在局限性，需要一种既能保持星座结构又能进行高效连续优化的确定性检测框架。
AI.method: 提出确定性平滑最大后验（SMAP）框架，将离散星座先验近似为独立同分布高斯混合模型，利用连续优化结合退火延拓法；对于硬判决提出SMAP-KR（结合局部$K_R$邻域搜索）；对于软输出利用后验平滑曲率的局部高斯近似计算符号概率和LLR。
AI.result: 数值结果表明，在临界负载的MU-MIMO系统中，SMAP-KR随着系统维度的增加提供了更优的性能-复杂度折衷，并能有效精炼现有检测器的输出；软SMAP在编码传输中比LMMSE和K-best软检测获得了显著的块差错率（BLER）增益。
AI.conclusion: SMAP框架为高维MIMO系统提供了一种强大且灵活的确定性优化检测方案，无论在硬判决还是软判决场景下均表现出显著的性能和复杂度优势。
AI.translation: 我们提出了一种用于高维多输入多输出（MIMO）检测的确定性平滑最大后验（SMAP）框架。离散星座先验被近似为独立同分布的高斯混合，产生了一个可微分的MAP目标函数，该函数在保持星座结构的同时能够进行连续优化。与基于采样的方法不同，SMAP将检测表述为一个确定性优化问题，并且可以由任意检测器的输出初始化，使其既可以作为独立检测器，也可以作为精炼阶段。对于硬判决，我们引入了SMAP-KR，它将连续解与根据原始最大似然度量评估的局部 $K_R$ 邻域搜索相补充。退火延拓法提高了对高阶星座的鲁棒性，而双邻域近似降低了评估混合先验的成本。我们进一步开发了一种软输出SMAP方法，其中基于平滑后验曲率的局部高斯近似提供了符号概率和比特对数似然比，而无需后验采样或显式的反假设列表。临界负载MU-MIMO系统的数值结果表明，随着系统维度的增长，SMAP-KR提供了越来越有利的性能-复杂度权衡，并且可以有效地精炼现有检测器的输出。对于编码传输，软SMAP在LMMSE和基于K-best的软检测之上提供了显著的块差错率增益。
AI.summary: 该论文针对高维MIMO系统提出了一种确定性平滑最大后验（SMAP）检测框架，通过将星座先验近似为高斯混合模型并结合连续优化、局部邻域搜索及曲率软输出方法，实现了硬判决与软判决的高效、高性能检测。
AI.keywords: MIMO检测, 最大后验概率, 确定性优化, 高斯混合模型, 软输出检测
AI.comments: 该论文提出了一种确定性平滑最大后验概率（SMAP）框架，将离散星座先验近似为高斯混合模型，实现了高维MIMO系统的高效检测。创新点在于通过确定性优化和局部邻域搜索（SMAP-KR）以及基于曲率的软输出计算，在保持较低复杂度的同时获得了优异的性能，且可作为独立检测器或现有检测器的精炼阶段。

title: Polyhedral Methods for Cooperative Games: Small Lifts and Hard Faces
summary:
We study the computational complexity of fundamental algorithmic problems -- membership testing, separation, valid-inequality testing, and linear optimization -- over polytopes and cones arising from cooperative games (also known as pseudo-Boolean functions). A central obstacle in the study of such problems is that a general cooperative game on $n$ players requires $2^n$ values, so the input size is $2^n$ for a game with $n$ players, making these computational tasks theoretically trivial. Restricting to $k$-additive games reduces the input size to $O(n^k)$, making such games a natural target for meaningful questions about the existence of efficient algorithms.
  On the positive side, we give an explicit extended formulation of size $O(n^k)$ for the core of $k$-additive $k$-monotone games, allowing all four problems to be solved by a single polynomial-size linear program -- in particular, circumventing the ellipsoid method that is needed when building from earlier tractability results of Deng and Papadimitriou, or of Edmonds. For the cone of $k$-additive $(k{-}1)$-monotone games, we give a complete characterization of its extreme rays and derive the same $O(n^k)$ bound on extension complexity, yielding a geometry-based proof and generalization of a result of Billionnet and Minoux.
  On the negative side, we show that for $l \leq k-2$ the cone of $k$-additive $l$-monotone games is computationally intractable: membership testing is not in NP (unless NP\,=\,coNP), valid-inequality testing is NP-complete, and extension complexity is at least $1.5^n$. Our hardness results yield, as a special case, a result of Crama and of Gallo and Simone. Furthermore, our hardness results also explain the lack of any good characterization of the extreme rays of the cone of $k$-additive $(k{-}2)$-monotone games.

AI.title_translation: 合作博弈的多面体方法：小型提升与困难面
AI.tldr: 本文揭示了k-加性合作博弈多面体在不同单调性条件下的计算复杂性分水岭：高阶单调性可被多项式大小的线性规划高效求解，而低阶单调性则具有极高的计算难解性。
AI.motivation: 传统的合作博弈需要$2^n$个输入值，为了研究有意义的算法效率，限制在$k$-additive博弈中将输入大小降为$O(n^k)$，以此探究多面体和锥上基本算法问题（如隶属度测试、分离、有效不等式测试和线性优化）的计算复杂性边界。
AI.method: 研究了k-additive和l-monotone合作博弈所产生的多面体和锥，通过构造显式的扩展公式（extended formulation）和分析其极射线（extreme rays）来证明正面结果；同时利用复杂性理论证明负面结果和难解性。
AI.result: 对于k-additive k-monotone博弈的核心，给出了大小为$O(n^k)$的显式扩展公式，可通过多项式大小的线性规划解决四大核心问题；对于$(k-1)$-monotone博弈的锥给出了极射线的完整刻画和相同的扩展复杂度界。然而，对于$l \leq k-2$的$k$-additive $l$-monotone博弈，证明了其计算难解性（隶属度测试不在NP中，有效不等式测试是NP完全的，扩展复杂度至少为$1.5^n$）。
AI.conclusion: 本文通过对k-additive合作博弈多面体和锥的研究，明确划定了高效可解与计算难解的边界，证明了k-monotone时存在多项式大小的扩展表示，而(k-2)-monotone及以下则具有极高的计算复杂性。
AI.translation:
我们研究了由合作博弈（也称为伪布尔函数）产生的多面体和锥的基本算法问题——隶属度测试、分离、有效不等式测试和线性 optimization——的计算复杂性。研究这类问题的一个核心障碍是，关于$n$个参与者的通用合作博弈需要 $2^n$ 个值，因此对于一个有 $n$ 个参与者的博弈，输入大小为 $2^n$，这使得这些计算任务在理论上变得微不足道。将其限制在 $k$-additive 博弈将输入大小减少到 $O(n^k)$，使这类博弈成为探究高效算法存在性的自然目标。
在正面结果方面，我们给出了 $k$-additive $k$-monotone 博弈的核心大小为 $O(n^k)$ 的显式扩展公式，允许通过单一的多项式规模线性规划解决所有四个问题——特别是绕过了邓（Deng）和帕帕迪米特里乌（Papadimitriou），或埃德蒙兹（Edmonds）早期可解性结果所需的椭球法。对于 $k$-additive $(k{-}1)$-monotone 博弈的锥，我们给出了其极射线的完整刻画，并推导出了相同的 $O(n^k)$ 扩展复杂度界，从而为比利内（Billionnet）和米努克斯（Minoux）的结果提供了基于几何的证明和推广。
在负面结果方面，我们证明了对于 $l \leq k-2$，$k$-additive $l$-monotone 博弈的锥在计算上是难解的：隶属度测试不在 NP 中（除非 NP\,=\,coNP），有效不等式测试是 NP 完全的，并且扩展复杂度至少为 $1.5^n$。作为特例，我们的困难性结果推导出了克拉玛（Crama）以及加洛（Gallo）和西蒙尼（Simone）的结果。此外，我们的困难性结果也解释了为什么缺乏对 $k$-additive $(k{-}2)$-monotone 博弈锥的极射线的良好刻画。
AI.summary: 本文研究了合作博弈中多面体和锥的计算复杂性。针对$k$-additive $k$-monotone博弈，给出了$O(n^k)$大小的多项式规模线性规划；而对于$(k-2)$-monotone及以下的博弈，则证明了其计算难解性及超多项式的扩展复杂度。
AI.keywords: 合作博弈, 多面体方法, 计算复杂性, 扩展表示, k-加性博弈
AI.comments: 该论文深入探讨了合作博弈中多面体方法的计算复杂性，巧妙地将k-additive游戏与扩展 formulations（扩展表示）相结合，不仅给出了正面的高效算法和多项式大小的线性规划，还从理论上证明了当单调性阶数下降时的计算难解性，极大地丰富了博弈论与多面体组合优化的交叉研究。

title: Formal Verification of Proofs from Automated Theorem Provers for Higher-Order Logic
summary: We identify common challenges and requirements for verifying proofs from automated theorem provers in the Dedukti logical framework and develop a general methodology for deriving encodings of calculus rules and proof steps, including clausification. We then apply this methodology to the EP calculus for higher-order logic and integrate it into the automated theorem prover Leo-III. The resulting prototype reconstructs about 80% of generated proof steps automatically, making Leo-III the first higher-order automated theorem prover to support independently checkable proof reconstruction and providing a basis for cross-system reuse. The implementation uncovered several bugs in Leo-III.

AI.title_translation: 高阶逻辑自动化定理证明器证明的形式化验证
AI.tldr: 论文提出了一种在Dedukti中形式化验证高阶自动定理证明器证明的通用方法，并在Leo-III中成功实现，使其成为首个支持独立可检查证明重建的高阶自动定理证明器。
AI.motivation: 为了解决验证自动定理证明器在高阶逻辑中生成的证明所面临的共同挑战和需求，并使高阶自动定理证明器能够支持独立可检查的证明重建。
AI.method: 识别Dedukti逻辑框架中的通用挑战与需求，开发用于推导演算规则和证明步骤（包括子句化）编码的通用方法，将其应用于高阶逻辑的EP演算，并集成到Leo-III自动定理证明器中。
AI.result: 原型系统自动重建了约80%生成的证明步骤，使Leo-III成为首个支持独立可检查证明重建的高阶自动定理证明器，其实施过程还发现了Leo-III中的几个漏洞。
AI.conclusion: 通过在Dedukti中建立通用的编码和验证方法，并成功应用于Leo-III，该工作证明了高阶自动定理证明器输出独立可检查证明的可行性，并显著提升了系统的可信度。
AI.translation: 我们识别了在Dedukti逻辑框架中验证来自自动定理证明器的证明所面临的共同挑战和需求，并开发了一种通用的方法来推导演算规则和证明步骤（包括子句化）的编码。然后，我们将该方法应用于高阶逻辑的EP演算，并将其集成到自动定理证明器Leo-III中。所得原型自动重建了约80%生成的证明步骤，使Leo-III成为第一个支持独立可检查证明重建的高阶自动定理证明器，并为跨系统重用提供了基础。该实现揭示了Leo-III中的几个漏洞。
AI.summary: 该论文提出了一种在Dedukti逻辑框架中形式化验证高阶自动定理证明器（Leo-III）证明的通用方法，成功实现了约80%证明步骤的自动重建，并发现了多个系统漏洞。
AI.keywords: 形式化验证, 自动定理证明, 高阶逻辑, 证明重建, Dedukti
AI.comments: 该论文首次实现了高阶自动定理证明器Leo-III中独立可检查的证明重建，并通过在Dedukti逻辑框架中形式化验证证明，发现了工具中的多个漏洞，对跨系统重用和高阶逻辑自动推理的可靠性具有重要意义。

title: Applications of Neural Cellular Automata: State of the Art, Challenges and Opportunities
summary: Neural Cellular Automata (NCAs) are a new type of neural network architecture which enable accurate and robust inference at extremely small model sizes. Recently, NCAs have advanced to become interesting low-resource alternatives to convolution- and attention-based architectures for various tasks such as image analysis, synthetic image generation, and simulation. The rapid development and increased research interest necessitate a comprehensive review of the emerging technology. This review provides an overview of the fundamentals of NCAs, applications to medical imaging, as well as insights into the state of the art. We analyze recent modifications to the originally proposed NCA architecture with respect to their efficiency and accuracy. Furthermore, we review practical applications in real-world scenarios with a focus on medical image analysis, segmentation, classification, registration, depth estimation, and image synthesis. Finally, we identify several advantages of NCAs, research gaps, and conclude with an analysis of future opportunities for NCAs in medical applications in confined settings or areas that have particular demands for robustness or efficient data processing.

AI.title_translation: 神经细胞自动机的应用：现状、挑战与机遇
AI.tldr: 本文全面综述了神经网络细胞自动机（NCA）的基础、架构改进及其在医学图像分析等低资源、高鲁棒性场景中的最新应用与未来机遇。
AI.motivation: 随着神经网络细胞自动机（NCA）作为一种轻量且鲁棒的新型架构在多项任务中快速发展并引起广泛研究兴趣，亟需对其最新技术进展、挑战及应用进行一次全面的综述。
AI.method: 通过文献综述，回顾了NCA的基础原理，分析了原始NCA架构的近期修改及其在效率和准确性上的表现，并重点审查了其在医学影像分析（分割、分类、配准、深度估计）和图像合成等实际场景中的应用。
AI.result: 总结了NCA在医学影像及其他任务中的最新应用现状，揭示了其在资源受限设置、鲁棒性要求高以及高效数据处理场景下的独特优势，并识别了当前的架构效率、准确性及研究空白。
AI.conclusion: NCA作为一种新兴的低资源、高鲁棒性神经网络架构，在医学图像分析等领域展现出巨大应用前景，同时也面临诸多亟待填补的研究空白与挑战。
AI.translation: 神经网络细胞自动机（NCA）是一种新型的神经网络架构，能够在极小的模型尺寸下实现准确且稳健的推理。近年来，NCA已发展成为卷积和注意力机制架构的有趣低资源替代方案，适用于图像分析、合成图像生成和仿真等各种任务。快速的发展和日益增长的研究兴趣使得对这一新兴技术进行全面综述成为必要。本综述概述了NCA的基本原理、在医学影像中的应用以及对最新技术的见解。我们分析了最初提出的NCA架构的近期修改，评估了它们的效率和准确性。此外，我们回顾了真实场景中的实际应用，重点关注医学图像分析、分割、分类、配准、深度估计和图像合成。最后，我们指出了NCA的几个优势、研究空白，并总结了NCA在资源受限环境或对鲁棒性和高效数据处理有特殊需求的医学应用领域的未来机遇。
AI.summary: 本文对神经网络细胞自动机（NCA）这一新兴神经网络架构进行了全面综述。文章梳理了NCA的基本原理、架构改进及其在图像分析、合成和仿真中的应用，重点聚焦于其在医学图像分割、分类、配准等实际场景中的表现，并展望了其在受限环境下的未来机遇与挑战。
AI.keywords: 神经网络细胞自动机, 医疗图像分析, 低资源模型, 综述, 架构改进
AI.comments: 本文首次对神经网络细胞自动机（NCA）在医疗影像等领域的应用进行了全面的现状综述，分析了其在低资源、高鲁棒性场景下的巨大潜力与挑战，对未来研究具有重要指导意义。

title: Aligning HOL-Light and Rocq libraries formally
summary: We report on our efforts to translate HOL-Light theorems on HOL-Light types/functions into Rocq theorems on Rocq types/functions. To this end, we developed in Rocq tactics to automate the proofs required for replacing a HOL-Light inductive type or recursive function definition by an equivalent but more idiomatic one in Rocq. We also explain how we replaced the definition of real numbers, as well as a number of mathematical notions like Rn spaces and the definition of limit, hence providing to Rocq users many definitions and theorems in logic and analysis that had not been formalized in Rocq before.

AI.title_translation: 形式化对齐 HOL-Light 与 Rocq 库
AI.tldr: 通过在 Rocq 中开发自动化战术，成功将 HOL-Light 的逻辑与分析学数学库对齐并迁移到了 Rocq 中。
AI.motivation: 为了将 HOL-Light 中大量的数学定理和类型/函数翻译并对齐到 Rocq 中，从而为 Rocq 用户提供此前尚未形式化的丰富逻辑和分析学定义与定理。
AI.method: 在 Rocq 中开发了自动化证明的战术（tactics），用于将 HOL-Light 的归纳类型或递归函数定义替换为 Rocq 中等价且更地道的定义；并重构了实数、Rn 空间及极限等数学概念的定义。
AI.result: 实现了 HOL-Light 库到 Rocq 库的形式化对齐，为 Rocq 引入了大量先前未曾形式化的逻辑和分析学定义与定理。
AI.conclusion: 成功将 HOL-Light 的定理和类型/函数翻译为 Rocq 的等价定理和定义，填补了 Rocq 在相关分析领域的空白。
AI.translation: 我们报告了将 HOL-Light 关于 HOL-Light 类型/函数的定理翻译为关于 Rocq 类型/函数的 Rocq 定理的工作。为此，我们在 Rocq 中开发了自动化证明所需的战术，以便用 Rocq 中等价但更地道的定义来替换 HOL-Light 的归纳类型或递归函数定义。我们还解释了如何替换实数的定义，以及诸如 Rn 空间和极限定义等许多数学概念，从而为 Rocq 用户提供了许多以前未在 Rocq 中形式化的逻辑和分析学定义与定理。
AI.summary: 该论文介绍了将 HOL-Light 的定理、类型和函数形式化翻译并对齐到 Rocq 库的工作。作者在 Rocq 中开发了自动化战术，用于处理归纳类型和递归函数的等价替换，并重新定义了实数、Rn 空间及极限等概念，从而为 Rocq 扩充了大量的逻辑与分析学数学资产。
AI.keywords: 形式化证明, 证明助手, HOL-Light, Rocq, 库对齐
AI.comments: 该工作在形式化数学库的对齐和复用方面取得了重要进展，通过自动化证明将 HOL-Light 的丰富数学资产（如实数、Rn空间、极限等）迁移到 Rocq 中，极大地丰富了 Rocq 的数学库。

title: Encoding Lean's Type Theory in Dedukti
summary: The Lean proof assistant has a rich library of mathematical formalizations that are interesting to users of other proof assistants. To help with the translation of this library to other systems, we present a theory in the Dedukti logical framework in which one can encode Lean terms and types, and define a typability-preserving translation from some large subset of Lean to that Dedukti theory.

title: Multi-Period Repetitive Control Design in a Time Delay Framework with Application to an Active Vibration Isolation System
summary:
Multi-period Repetitive Control (MPRC) can lead to amplification at non-repetitive frequencies due to the multiplication of multi-period repetitive control in their closed-loop sensitivity functions, which leads to closed-to imaginary poles. We propose a MPRC structure that eliminates such interaction.
  The scheme can be equivalently converted into a disturbance observer to improve robustness to frequency uncertainties. We derive an upper bound on the sensitivity function that can be optimized at either repetitive or non-repetitive frequencies. Experimental results on an active vibration isolation system show superior performance over existing robust MPRC schemes, and the capability to suppress unknown time-varying periodic disturbances.

title: GraphToolbox: A Configurable Python Framework for Graph Neural Network Forecasting
summary: Electricity forecasting often involves spatially related signals observed over regions, substations, and feeders, and Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) provide a natural way to represent these relations. Building a complete GNN forecasting experiment is nonetheless laborious, because graph construction, model selection, training, aggregation, and interpretation sit in incompatible tools. We present GraphToolbox, an open-source Python framework that unifies these stages in one configurationdriven pipeline built on PyTorch Geometric. It offers data-driven graph construction, an adapter that instantiates and trains 51 of the 65 PyTorch Geometric convolutions together with the recurrent cells of PyTorch Geometric Temporal, online expert aggregation, forecasting interpretability, and significance testing on cached forecasts. We evaluate the pipeline in two case studies. On French regional load, the 48 convolutions included in the complete forecasting sweep fall in a band from 1.14% to 1.60% error, online aggregation lowers this to 0.98%, and the graph models improve on classical additive and boosting baselines. On net-load, direct graph models are less accurate than a classical additive model, while forecasting each physical component separately improves them without closing that gap. Both comparisons use the same experimental interface, illustrating the role of GraphToolbox in systematic architectural evaluation.

title: Beyond Uniform Subspaces: Spectrum-Aware and Depth-Adaptive Fusion for Multi-Task Model Merging
summary: Model merging aims to consolidate multiple task-specific models without access to extra training process. However, existing subspace-based methods largely rely on a uniform treatment of task updates, overlooking their intrinsic spectral and depth-wise heterogeneity. We identify two key deviations from this assumption: different tasks require different subspace capacity and exhibit different tolerance to spectral transformation, while subspace projection introduces depth-dependent distortion. Based on these observations, we propose SADA-Merging, a spectrum-aware and depth-adaptive framework for data-free model merging. SADA-Merging allocates task-specific subspace capacity according to spectral complexity, adapts spectral preservation according to task-wise plasticity, and applies depth-dependent anchoring to compensate for projection-induced distortion. This enables the fusion process to adapt to both the intrinsic geometry of each task and its sensitivity across network depth. SADA-Merging operates directly on task updates and is applicable to both full fine-tuning and LoRA settings. Extensive experiments demonstrate consistent improvements over existing data-free merging methods across different task scales and adaptation settings.

title: UK-PRBENCH: A Paragraph-Level Precedent Retrieval Benchmark for United Kingdom Case Law
summary: Prior case retrieval (PCR) aims to identify precedent cases relevant to a given query case. Existing PCR benchmarks and methods predominantly operate at the document level, treating entire judgments as the unit of relevance. This formulation is suboptimal for legal practitioners, as judgments address multiple legal issues and only a small subset of paragraphs is relevant to a particular query. Addressing this gap, we introduce UK-PRBench, a benchmark for paragraph-level precedent retrieval in UK case law, constructed from judgments obtained from the UK National Archives and covering a broad range of UK courts and tribunals. Furthermore, we evaluate state-of-the-art retrieval models and establish baseline results. Our experiments show that paragraph-level precedent retrieval remains challenging for current retrieval approaches, highlighting substantial room for improvement. UK-PRBench provides a standardised benchmark for evaluating fine-grained precedent retrieval and advancing retrieval systems for the UK legal domain.

title: Structure-Aware Rendering: How Code Reveal Shapes Programmers' Visual Attention
summary: AI coding interfaces present generated code either all at once or token-by-token. These rendering strategies reflect model generation rather than how programmers actually read code: selectively, non-linearly, and guided by the structure. We argue that code rendering is a first-class interaction primitive that shapes how programmers read and understand code. To explore this design space, we introduce structured rendering, a technique that reveals code in semantically meaningful chunks derived from its syntactic hierarchy, exposing high-level structure before low-level details. To isolate rendering effects on visual attention, we conducted an eye-tracking study with 53 participants comparing static, character-based, and structured rendering. Our findings show that rendering alters visual attention and reading behavior: dynamic rendering induces fewer but longer fixations and more sustained focus, while structured rendering further guides attention toward semantically meaningful units and supports high-level understanding. We release the anonymized dataset with an interactive demo (https://codegaze.vercel.app/) to support future research.

title: Video-based Surgical Skill Assessment Using Dynamics-and-Uncertainty-Aware Tree-based Gaussian Process Classifier
comments: 4 figures, 17 tables, 31 pages. It is Under Review in scientific reports Journal
summary: The proposed pipeline integrates a representation-flow convolutional neural network with a dynamics- and uncertainty-aware tree-based Gaussian Process classifier. In this framework, latent motion dynamics are exploited both as discriminative representations and as a source of input uncertainty, enhancing robustness against temporal variations and abnormal motion transitions. Compared with conventional deep learning approaches, the proposed strategy requires less training data and offers improved computational efficiency. To further improve classification performance, we introduce novel semantic-aware compound kernels that effectively capture semantic, flow, and dynamic information embedded in surgical video features. In addition, uncertainty-aware kernels are developed to strengthen the robustness and practical applicability of the compound kernel framework. The proposed method is evaluated on two benchmark datasets, namely the JIGSAWS and the Cataract-LMM (Capsulorhexis) datasets. Experimental results demonstrate strong performance across both datasets, including the LOSO and LOUO evaluation protocols on JIGSAWS, including the subject-independent LOUO protocol on JIGSAWS, on which the framework attains a mean accuracy of \ph{96.9}\%; results under the within-subject LOSO protocol are reported for comparability with prior work, achieving competitive accuracy while substantially reducing computational cost. Overall, the proposed pipeline provides an efficient and accurate framework for video-based surgical skill assessment.

title: Ascent: An Agentic System over the Model Context Protocol for Real-World Clinical Data Analysis
summary: Answering epidemiological questions from real-world clinical data requires medical coding, schema-aware SQL, and validation of implicit choices about populations, denominators, and time. We present Ascent, an agentic system that exposes medical coding, question answering, and cohort analysis through a shared Model Context Protocol tool surface for standardized and native schemas. We introduce EpiTrap, a dataset testing whether systems avoid recognized pharmacoepidemiological errors, and compare a fixed pipeline with agents across models and orchestrators. With capable models, agents improve accuracy over the fixed pipeline by an average of 27 and 20 percentage points on native and standardized schemas, respectively. These gains require more tool calls and longer runtimes. Experience from real projects highlights the system's value for feasibility assessment, diagnostic iteration, and expert-guided analysis.

title: Learning tactile perception from high-bandwidth single-point sensing
summary:
Tactile sensing is increasingly being incorporated into learning-based robotic manipulation, yet many existing approaches rely on spatially distributed sensors. Here we introduce SpectRobot, a framework that transforms single-point tactile signals into compact time-frequency spectrograms. These spectrograms encode high-bandwidth tactile histories as fixed-size image-like representations. They can be processed by standard vision encoders and integrated into learning pipelines originally developed for vision, while preserving temporal and frequency information unavailable to conventional cameras.
  Rather than increasing spatial density through arrays of tactile elements, SpectRobot exploits the rich dynamics contained in sparse, high-bandwidth single-point measurements. In our implementation, the sensors are mounted away from the contact surface while remaining mechanically coupled to it, reducing direct exposure to wear and potentially improving robustness in harsh environments and for long-term deployment on dexterous robots.
  Our experiments demonstrate that: (1) a robot can exploit single-point vibration signals to solve a visually occluded manipulation task; (2) temporal history strongly influences policy performance, while sensing bandwidth controls the spectral information available, with measurements extending to 100~kHz; and (3) the same representation can be used across different tactile sensing technologies mediated by acceleration, force, or strain. We further show that capabilities previously associated with research-grade instrumentation can be accessed using readily available, off-the-shelf hardware. We believe that broader access to high-bandwidth tactile sensing could facilitate the integration of contact dynamics into embodied learning systems and, for some tasks, offer an alternative or complement to increasing the spatial density of tactile sensing.

title: A priori regularity of the reverse heat flow and dimension-dependent complexity of higher-order diffusion samplers
summary: We establish arbitrary-order a priori regularity estimates for the reverse heat flow in the Ornstein--Uhlenbeck setting, that is, for the probability-flow ODE of score-based diffusion models. For compactly supported, possibly singular targets satisfying a dimension-uniform doubling condition on supporting-cap masses, we bound the iterated material derivatives of the flow and their first spatial derivatives pointwise, with constants independent of the dimension $d$ and explicit in time and support radius. The proof rests on two ingredients: a spatially uniform bound on normal-direction posterior fluctuations, which is the only point where the geometry of the target enters, and a centered posterior-moment normal form closed under material differentiation. This algebraic structure, together with a weighted regularity calculus, yields quantitative bounds at every order, including the mixed space--time directional derivatives required by Runge--Kutta stages. As an application, for exact-score sampling stopped at forward time $δ>0$, order-$p$ Taylor and explicit Runge--Kutta schemes reach accuracy $\varepsilon$ in $\widetilde O(d^{1/p}\varepsilon^{-1/p})$ steps in total variation, and the Taylor scheme in $\widetilde O(d^{1/(2p)}\varepsilon^{-1/p})$ steps in $W_2$.

title: Vertex Cover Interdiction in Bipartite Graphs
summary: In the vertex cover interdiction problem, we are given an undirected graph $G=(V,E)$, two integers $t$ and $k$ and a vertex subset $B\subseteq V$, and we are asked to find a set $X \subseteq B$ with $|X|\leq t$ such that $X$ hits (i.e., intersects) all the vertex covers of $G$ of size at most $k$. Recently, Grüne and Wulf proved that the problem is $Σ_2^p$-complete. However, their reduction relied on the fact that the vertex cover problem is NP-complete. This, in turn, means that we do not know the complexity status of the vertex cover interdiction problem when the input graph is restricted to a bipartite graph since the vertex cover problem can be solved in polynomial time for bipartite graphs. One of our main results shows that the vertex cover interdiction problem is NP-complete for bipartite graphs. In contrast, when $k$ is restricted to the minimum vertex cover size, i.e., we are only required to hit all the minimum vertex covers, we show that the vertex cover interdiction problem can be solved in polynomial time for bipartite graphs. This motivates us to study the parameterized complexity of the vertex cover interdiction problem for bipartite graphs when the difference of $k$ and the minimum vertex cover size is taken as a parameter. With this parameter, we show that the problem is $\mathrm{W}[1]$-hard, but can be solved in polynomial time when the parameter is constant (i.e., in XP time). We also show that the problem is fixed-parameter tractable when parameterized by $k$.

title: Custom Named Entity Recognition and Topic Classification for Global Health Publications
summary: How should natural language processing models be selected and adapted for global health literature in environments where annotated data and computational resources are limited? This thesis investigates these challenges through experiments on semantic tag discovery, named entity recognition (NER), and multi-label topic classification. First, skip-gram word2vec models trained on progressively larger specialized corpora are compared with BioWordVec to assess how corpus size and domain context influence tag discovery. Vocabulary coverage and qualitative evaluation indicate that broader coverage does not necessarily yield more useful domain-specific associations. The analysis then turns to entity extraction, comparing convolutional spaCy models with a RoBERTa-based transformer on 1,000 annotated sentences. Under a lenient scoring protocol, the transformer achieves 0.80 micro-F1 versus 0.65-0.69 for convolutional models, but takes 82 seconds rather than 5-6 seconds. This trade-off motivates fine-tuning convolutional models and integrating a disease recognizer that achieves 81.33% test F1 on the NCBI Disease Corpus. Combined with PDF preprocessing, entity filtering, and MeSH enrichment, the resulting pipeline supports document-level indexing. To complement entity extraction with thematic annotation, MiniLM-based few-shot classification is compared with BART-MNLI zero-shot inference across 50 topics and 1,000 handcrafted test sentences. BART-MNLI achieves 95.2% single-label accuracy versus 59%; reported multi-label accuracies are 88% and 32% under partly manual assessment. However, its higher inference cost limits practical integration. The results show where domain specialization and lightweight adaptation offer practical value, and where transformer accuracy justifies higher inference costs, providing an empirical basis for building knowledge systems under resource constraints.

title: Relationally Grounded Latent World Models for Autonomous Driving
comments: Accepted at the NeuRo-SymBolic World Models (RoBoWoMo) Workshop at IROS 2026
summary: Latent world models learn predictive representations for autonomous driving, but the relational semantics these states preserve often remain implicit. We investigate whether traffic scene graphs can serve as privileged semantic supervision for latent world representations. Building on LAW, we construct actor-centric scene graphs from nuScenes 3D annotations, encode their serialized relational structure using a frozen text embedding model, and align the visual latent representations with this semantic target during training. We remove the supervision branch at inference, so it requires neither scene graphs nor 3D annotations and adds no test-time computation. On nuScenes, our method reduces average trajectory L2 error from 0.661 to 0.622 (5.9%) and collision rate from 0.456 to 0.217 (52.4%) relative to our retrained LAW baseline. It also outperforms an unstructured caption-style semantic target, supporting the benefit of explicit relational structure for latent world-model representation learning.

title: FedMust: Semi-supervised Multi-task Student-Teacher Federated Learning for Multi-organ CT Segmentation
comments: This manuscript has been accepted for publication at the 7th International Conference on Medical Imaging and Computer-Aided Diagnosis (MICAD 2026)
summary: Multi-organ segmentation using deep learning requires large amounts of annotated patient data; however, institutions often lack sufficiently large and diverse annotated datasets. Privacy constraints further prevent institutions from sharing patient data to overcome this limitation. Moreover, due to the labor-intensive nature of annotation and the scarcity of diverse expertise, institutions typically have labels for only a small portion of their local data, leaving the larger unlabeled portion unused. In this work, we propose a flexible semi-supervised federated multi-task student-teacher framework that leverages federated learning (FL) to improve multi-organ segmentation using both labeled and unlabeled data across participating sites. At each communication round, the proposed framework initiates local training, where clients with labels for the same task form a federation to produce an aggregated teacher model. The resulting teachers generate task-specific features for all data at each client. Subsequently, all clients form a second federation to train a multi-task student model with a shared encoder and task-specific decoders that replicate the teacher-generated features across all segmentation tasks. The aggregated student model is then used to update the local teachers and initiate the next training round. Extensive experiments demonstrated the effectiveness of the proposed method compared with local and federated single-organ models, yielding an average performance gain of 13 percent across clients. The experiments also demonstrated the impact of multi-task learning and unlabeled data and the applicability of the framework in relaxing labeled-data requirements for client participation. The code is available at https://github.com/AshknMrd/FedMust.
